youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用「夜間火車」情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），共 800 句、400 輪，全程只發生在夜行臥鋪列車上：月台臨時改號、問包廂在第幾節車廂、把行李塞進床下與爬梯子上鋪、跟服務員要一套床單、把晚餐托盤端進小包廂、十點熄燈後的安靜、半夜踩著拖鞋找水喝、以及清晨的早點車與到站廣播。全部以 A2 級簡易句寫成，句句對應中文翻譯，睡前循環播放即可。#英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical 'Taking the Overnight Train' phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue) — 800 sentences, 400 turns, all on the night sleeper: a platform change at the last minute, asking which carriage holds your room, stowing luggage and climbing the ladder, requesting a fresh sheet, carrying dinner back to the berth, the quiet after lights-out at ten, hunting for water at two in the morning, and the breakfast cart with the arrival announcement. Easy A2 sentences on repeat. #EnglishListening #SleepEnglish #LearnEnglish

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the north platform still open tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə nɔrθ ˈplætfɔrm stɪl ˈoʊpən təˈnaɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 今晚北月台還開著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, they moved the sleeper train to six.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðeɪ muvd ðə ˈsliːpər treɪn tu sɪks./
dialogue.zh: 沒有，他們把臥舖列車改到六號月台了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where can I check the new platform number?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr kæn aɪ tʃɛk ðə nu ˈplætfɔrm ˈnʌmbər?/
dialogue.zh: 我要在哪裡查新的月台號碼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look at the screen above the coffee stand.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk ət ðə skrin əˈbʌv ðə ˈkɔfi stænd./
dialogue.zh: 去看咖啡台上方那塊螢幕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says our sleeper train is on six now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt sɛz ˈaʊər ˈsliːpər treɪn ɪz ɔn sɪks naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 螢幕說我們那班臥舖火車現在停在六號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That board updates every two minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðət bɔrd ˈʌpˌdeɪts ˈɛvri tu ˈmɪnɪts./
dialogue.zh: 那塊看板每兩分鐘更新一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did they change the leaving time as well?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðeɪ tʃeɪndʒ ðə ˈlivɪŋ taɪm əz wɛl?/
dialogue.zh: 出發時間也一起改了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Still eight forty, so we have time to walk.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɪl eɪt ˈfɔrti soʊ wi hæv taɪm tu wɔk./
dialogue.zh: 還是八點四十，所以我們來得及慢慢走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the overnight train wait for us?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðə ˌoʊvərˈnaɪt treɪn weɪt fɔr ʌs?/
dialogue.zh: 夜間火車會等我們嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the doors shut ten minutes before we leave.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðə dɔrz ʃʌt tɛn ˈmɪnɪts bɪˈfɔr wi liv./
dialogue.zh: 不會，開車前十分鐘車門就關。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which way is platform six from this hall?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ weɪ ɪz ˈplætfɔrm sɪks frʌm ðɪs hɔl?/
dialogue.zh: 從這個大廳要怎麼走去六號月台？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Down the stairs, then left by the vending machines.
dialogue.phonetic: /daʊn ðə stɛrz ðɛn lɛft baɪ ðə ˈvɛndɪŋ məˈʃinz./
dialogue.zh: 走下樓梯，再在自動販賣機那側左轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the escalators run past eight tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ði ˌɛskəˈletərz rʌn pæst eɪt təˈnaɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 今晚八點過後手扶梯還開嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, take the stairs with your big bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ teɪk ðə stɛrz wɪð jɔr bɪɡ bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 不開了，帶著大件行李請走樓梯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My suitcase is heavy on these steps.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈsutkeɪs ɪz ˈhɛvi ɔn ðiz stɛps./
dialogue.zh: 我這只行李箱在階梯上好重。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can lift it while you hold the rail.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn lɪft ɪt waɪl ju hoʊld ðə reɪl./
dialogue.zh: 我來抬，你先扶好欄杆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone left boxes across the lower stair.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmwʌn lɛft ˈbɑksɪz əˈkrɔs ðə ˈloʊər stɛr./
dialogue.zh: 有人把紙箱堆在下半段階梯上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Step over slowly and keep your hand free.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɛp ˈoʊvər ˈsloʊli ænd kip jɔr hænd fri./
dialogue.zh: 慢慢跨過去，手要空出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this corridor open to the night trains?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs ˈkɔrəˌdɔr ˈoʊpən tu ðə naɪt treɪnz?/
dialogue.zh: 這條通道通往夜間列車嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, walk straight and you will see six.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wɔk streɪt ænd ju wɪl si sɪks./
dialogue.zh: 是的，直走就會看見六號月台。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The speakers crackle every few minutes here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈspikərz ˈkrækl ˈɛvri fju ˈmɪnɪts hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 在這裡廣播每幾分鐘就嘩啦響一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A short chime means a platform just changed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ʃɔrt tʃaɪm minz ə ˈplætfɔrm dʒʌst tʃeɪndʒd./
dialogue.zh: 短促的叮聲代表月台剛剛又改了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did that voice say we hold at platform six?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðæt vɔɪs seɪ wi hoʊld ət ˈplætfɔrm sɪks?/
dialogue.zh: 那個廣播是說我們在六號月台等嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it waits two minutes for late passengers.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt weɪts tu ˈmɪnɪts fɔr leɪt ˈpæsəndʒərz./
dialogue.zh: 對，它會等晚到的旅客兩分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is cold out here with all this wind.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz koʊld aʊt hɪr wɪð ɔl ðɪs wɪnd./
dialogue.zh: 外頭風這麼大，真是冷。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stand under the lamp where the wall blocks it.
dialogue.phonetic: /stænd ˈʌndər ðə læmp wɛr ðə wɔl blɑks ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 站到燈下面，那面牆能擋風。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two people are sleeping on that far bench.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈpipəl ɑr ˈslipɪŋ ɔn ðæt fɑr bɛntʃ./
dialogue.zh: 那張遠處的長椅上睡著兩個人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They missed the last bus, so they wait here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ mɪst ðə læst bʌs soʊ ðeɪ weɪt hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 他們錯末班車，只能在這裡等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is anyone else standing near this yellow line?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ˈɛniwʌn ɛls ˈstændɪŋ nɪr ðɪs ˈjɛloʊ laɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 還有別人站在黃色線旁邊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only us, and one girl with her dad.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ʌs ænd wʌn ɡɜrl wɪθ hɜr dæd./
dialogue.zh: 只剩我們，還有一位女孩和她的爸爸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When does the gate for our train close?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛn dʌz ðə ɡeɪt fɔr ˈaʊər treɪn kloʊz?/
dialogue.zh: 我們那班車的閘門幾點關？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three minutes before the wheels begin to turn.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ˈmɪnɪts bɪˈfɔr ðə wilz bɪˈɡɪn tu tɜrn./
dialogue.zh: 輪子開始轉之前三分鐘就關。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we show our paper or our phone here?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi ʃoʊ ˈaʊər ˈpeɪpər ɔr ˈaʊər foʊn hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 在這裡要出示紙票還是手機？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The scanner takes either one, phone is faster.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈskænər teɪks ˈiðər wʌn foʊn ɪz ˈfæstər./
dialogue.zh: 讀票機兩種都收，用手機比較快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I stamp the night ticket?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du aɪ stæmp ðə naɪt ˈtɪkɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 夜間車票要在哪裡打戳記？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a small box beside the gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə smɔl bɑks bəˈsaɪd ðə ɡeɪt./
dialogue.zh: 閘門旁邊就有一台小打卡機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My seat note says compartment, not a seat.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ sit noʊt sɛz kəmˈpɑrtmənt nɑt ə sit./
dialogue.zh: 我的票寫的是臥舖，不是座位。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means one sleeping room for tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt minz wʌn ˈslipɪŋ rum fɔr təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 那就是今晚睡的一間小寢室。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the train stop at every little station?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðə treɪn stɑp ət ˈɛvri ˈlɪtəl ˈsteɪʃən?/
dialogue.zh: 這班車每個小站都會停嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it runs dark through most of the night.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ɪt rʌnz dɑrk θru moʊst ʌv ðə naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 不會，夜裡大半路程都是直開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here it comes, I hear the rails humming.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪt kʌmz aɪ hɪr ðə reɪlz ˈhʌmɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 來了，我聽見鐵軌在嗡嗡響。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stand back until the wheels slow down fully.
dialogue.phonetic: /stænd bæk ʌnˈtɪl ðə wilz sloʊ daʊn ˈfʊli./
dialogue.zh: 先退後，等輪子完全慢下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The doors are opening along the whole side.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dɔrz ɑr ˈoʊpnɪŋ əˈlɔŋ ðə hoʊl saɪd./
dialogue.zh: 整側的車門都打開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: People are pushing, so hold your bag tight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpipəl ɑr ˈpʊʃɪŋ soʊ hoʊld jɔr bæɡ taɪt./
dialogue.zh: 人群在推擠，行李要抓緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are we boarding at the front or the middle?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr wi ˈbɔrdɪŋ ət ðə frʌnt ɔr ðə ˈmɪdəl?/
dialogue.zh: 我們該從車頭還是中間上車？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Middle doors, the first car is only staff.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɪdəl dɔrz ðə fɜrst kɑr ɪz ˈoʊnli stæf./
dialogue.zh: 中間那幾道門，第一節只有工作人員。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This step is high with my hands full.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs stɛp ɪz haɪ wɪð maɪ hændz fʊl./
dialogue.zh: 兩手都滿著，這台階好高。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put one foot up and grab the silver bar.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt wʌn fʊt ʌp ænd ɡræb ðə ˈsɪlvər bɑr./
dialogue.zh: 先踏上一隻腳，再抓那根金屬把手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the platform move again while we waited?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðə ˈplætfɔrm muv əˈɡɛn waɪl wi ˈweɪtəd?/
dialogue.zh: 我們等的時候月台又改了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, six is right, see the sign out there.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ sɪks ɪz raɪt si ðə saɪn aʊt ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 沒有，六號才對，看外面那塊牌子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So many bags on this narrow platform floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈmɛni bæɡz ɔn ðɪs ˈnɛroʊ ˈplætfɔrm flɔr./
dialogue.zh: 窄窄的月台地上全都是行李。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep your wheels close, or someone trips.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip jɔr wilz kloʊz ɔr ˈsʌmwʌn trɪps./
dialogue.zh: 拉輪式行李箱要貼著自己，不然會絆到人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the light by the door working tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə laɪt baɪ ðə dɔr ˈwɜrkɪŋ təˈnaɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 門口那盞燈今晚還亮嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mostly dark, so bring your bag inside now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmostli dɑrk soʊ brɪŋ jɔr bæɡ ɪnˈsaɪd naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 幾乎是黑的，所以快把行李拿進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more person and the doorway is full.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr ˈpɜrsən ænd ðə ˈdɔrˌweɪ ɪz fʊl./
dialogue.zh: 再多一個人門口就擠滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Move in and turn to the little red sign.
dialogue.phonetic: /muv ɪn ænd tɜrn tu ðə ˈlɪtəl rɛd saɪn./
dialogue.zh: 往裡走，轉到那個紅色小指標那側。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My ticket is for the fourth sleeping car.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈtɪkɪt ɪz fɔr ðə fɔrθ ˈslipɪŋ kɑr./
dialogue.zh: 我的票是在第四節寢車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then walk past the dining car up front.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wɔk pæst ðə ˈdaɪnɪŋ kɑr ʌp frʌnt./
dialogue.zh: 那就走過前面的餐車廂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The whistle sounds before the doors all shut.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈwɪsəl saʊndz bɪˈfɔr ðə dɔrz ɔl ʃʌt./
dialogue.zh: 車門全關之前笛聲會先響。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hear that long beep? We must step in fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ðæt lɔŋ bip wi mʌst stɛp ɪn fæst./
dialogue.zh: 聽見那聲長嗶了嗎？我們得趕快上車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We made it, the platform is sliding away.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi meɪd ɪt ðə ˈplætfɔrm ɪz ˈslaɪdɪŋ əˈweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我們趕上了，月台開始往後滑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Breathe slowly, that run was really far.
dialogue.phonetic: /brið ˈsloʊli ðæt rʌn wɔz ˈrɪli fɑr./
dialogue.zh: 慢慢呼吸，剛那段路真的跑太遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this our train, or did we board wrong?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs ˈaʊər treɪn ɔr dɪd wi bɔrd rɔŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 這是我們的車嗎，還是上錯節了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the blue sign says city names.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə blu saɪn sɛz ˈsɪti neɪmz./
dialogue.zh: 對了，藍色牌子上寫著城市名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Out the window, only fields and black sky.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊt ðə ˈwɪndoʊ ˈoʊnli filz ænd blæk skaɪ./
dialogue.zh: 窗外的田和一片黑天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pull the blind down and the cold stays out.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊl ðə blaɪnd daʊn ænd ðə koʊld steɪz aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 把簾子拉下來，寒氣就進不來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This corridor smells like iron and hot tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈkɔrəˌdɔr smɛlz laɪk ˈaɪərn ænd hɑt ti./
dialogue.zh: 這走廊有鐵味和熱茶味。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The kettle box at the end gives free cups.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkɛtl bɑks ət ði ɛnd ɡɪvz fri kʌps./
dialogue.zh: 車尾那台熱水桶會附免費紙杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the room marked twelve?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪz ðə rum mɑrkt twɛlv?/
dialogue.zh: 寫著十二號的那間包廂在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two doors down, on the left after the mirror.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu dɔrz daʊn ɔn ðə lɛft ˈæftər ðə ˈmɪrər./
dialogue.zh: 再過去兩道門，鏡子左邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every door looks the same in this low light.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri dɔr lʊks ðə seɪm ɪn ðɪs loʊ laɪt./
dialogue.zh: 燈光這麼暗，每道門看起來都一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The numbers glow small above each handle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈnʌmbərz ɡloʊ smɔl əˈbʌv itʃ ˈhændəl./
dialogue.zh: 每個把手上方有小小的數字在發光。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is room twelve open or still locked?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz rum twɛlv ˈoʊpən ɔr stɪl lɑkt?/
dialogue.zh: 十二號包廂是開著還是鎖著？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Locked, so knock twice and wait a moment.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɑkt soʊ nɑk twaɪs ænd weɪt ə ˈmoʊmənt./
dialogue.zh: 鎖著，所以敲兩下等一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A woman with gray hair opens the door now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈwʊmən wɪθ ɡreɪ hɛr ˈoʊpənz ðə dɔr naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 一位白髮女士把門打開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She smiles and waves my small bag inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi smaɪlz ænd weɪvz maɪ smɔl bæɡ ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 她笑著招手，把我的小包先請進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So you share this room with me tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ju ʃɛr ðɪs rum wɪθ mi təˈnaɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 今晚您是跟我共用這間包廂嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I already chose the bottom one.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪ ɔlˈrɛdi tʃoʊz ðə ˈbɑtəm wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 是的，我已經挑了下面那張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I need the window, is that okay with you?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ nid ðə ˈwɪndoʊ ɪz ðæt oʊˈkeɪ wɪð ju?/
dialogue.zh: 我想要窗邊，您可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, I sleep better away from glass.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr aɪ slip ˈbɛtər əˈweɪ frʌm ɡlæs./
dialogue.zh: 當然，我離窗子遠一點睡得更好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The station lights shrink small behind us now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈsteɪʃən laɪts ʃrɪŋ smɔl bɪˈhaɪnd ʌs naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 車站的燈現在在身後變得好小。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soon there is nothing but dark and rail sound.
dialogue.phonetic: /sun ðɛr ɪz ˈnʌθɪŋ bʌt dɑrk ænd reɪl saʊnd./
dialogue.zh: 一會兒就只剩黑和鐵軌聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did that man on platform six find his car?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðæt mæn ɑn ˈplætfɔrm sɪks faɪnd hɪz kɑr?/
dialogue.zh: 六號月台那個男人找到他的車廂了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He ran past the doors, poor guy, all alone.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi ræn pæst ðə dɔrz pʊr ɡaɪ ɔl əˈloʊn./
dialogue.zh: 他跑過車門了，可憐，只剩他一個人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I feel bad about leaving him standing there.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ fil bæd əˈbaʊt ˈlivɪŋ hɪm ˈstændɪŋ ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 把他留在那邊，我心裡很過意不去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The next train comes at half past midnight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə nɛkst treɪn kʌmz ət hæf pæst ˈmɪdaɪnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 下一班車半夜十二點半就來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do staff help with bags at every small stop?
dialogue.phonetic: /du stæf hɛlp wɪð bæɡz ət ˈɛvri smɔl stɑp?/
dialogue.zh: 小站也有人員幫忙搬行李嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only big stations, so keep your bag with you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli bɪɡ ˈsteɪʃənz soʊ kip jɔr bæɡ wɪð ju./
dialogue.zh: 只有大站有，所以行李要自己帶著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is my water bottle? I packed it somewhere.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪz maɪ ˈwɔtər ˈbɑtəl aɪ pækt ɪt ˈsʌmwɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 我的水瓶呢？我收在某個地方了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the side pocket near your left knee.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk ðə saɪd ˈpɑkɪt nɪr jɔr lɛft ni./
dialogue.zh: 看看你左膝旁邊那個側袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Found it, thanks for helping with the stairs.
dialogue.phonetic: /faʊnd ɪt θæŋks fɔr ˈhɛlpɪŋ wɪð ðə stɛrz./
dialogue.zh: 找到了，謝謝你方才陪我從樓梯上來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any time, we both need sleep before morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni taɪm wi boʊθ nid slip bɪˈfɔr ˈmɔrnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 不客氣，我們都得在早上之前睡一覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The ticket stub says breakfast is included here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈtɪkɪt stʌb sɛz ˈbrɛkfəst ɪz ɪnˈkludəd hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 票根上寫著車票含早餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, so we pay nothing in the morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd soʊ wi peɪ ˈnʌθɪŋ ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 那太好了，明早不用另外掏錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One last look, the night train is really here.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn læst lʊk ðə naɪt treɪn ɪz ˈrɪli hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 最後看一眼，夜間火車真的來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And in a minute the lights go out again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪn ə ˈmɪnɪt ðə laɪts ɡoʊ aʊt əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 再過一會兒燈就要熄了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me fold this map back in my coat.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi foʊld ðɪs mæp bæk ɪn maɪ koʊt./
dialogue.zh: 讓我的地圖摺回外套裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The pull cord is right above your head.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pʊl kɔrd ɪz raɪt əˈbʌv jɔr hɛd./
dialogue.zh: 拉繩就在你頭頂正上方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will sleep the whole way to the sea.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl slip ðə hoʊl weɪ tu ðə si./
dialogue.zh: 我想一路睡到海邊那站。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wake me when the mountains start to show.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪk mi wɛn ðə ˈmaʊntənz stɑrt tu ʃoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 山看得見的時候記得叫我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, does car four stay on this train?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuːz mi dʌz kɑr fɔr steɪ ɑn ðɪs treɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，四號車會留在這班車上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It does, room twelve is yours, upper bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɪt dʌz rum twɛlv ɪz jɔrz ˈʌpər bɛd./
dialogue.zh: 會留下來，十二號房是您的，上舖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is car four far from where I stand?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz kɑr fɔr fɑr frʌm wɛr aɪ stænd?/
dialogue.zh: 四號車離我現在的位置遠嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Walk past the dining door, about five minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔk pæst ðə ˈdaɪnɪŋ dɔr əˈbaʊt faɪv ˈmɪnɪts./
dialogue.zh: 走過餐車那道門，大約五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the car numbers sit above the doors?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðə kɑr ˈnʌmbərz sɪt əˈbʌv ðə dɔrz?/
dialogue.zh: 車廂號碼是寫在門的上方嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, small white plates near the ceiling light.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs smɔl waɪt pleɪts nɪr ðə ˈsilɪŋ laɪt./
dialogue.zh: 是的，天花板燈旁有小白牌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I see a six, so four must be behind.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si ə sɪks soʊ fɔr mʌst bi bɪˈhaɪnd./
dialogue.zh: 我看到六號，那四號應該在後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, this line runs odd on the far side.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðɪs laɪn rʌnz ɑd ɔn ðə fɑr saɪd./
dialogue.zh: 不對，這班車那頭是用單號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why are the sleepers split across the train?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ ɑr ðə ˈslipərz splɪt əˈkrɔs ðə treɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼臥舖車廂分散在整列車裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two groups, one for beds, one for seats.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ɡrupz wʌn fɔr bɛdz wʌn fɔr sits./
dialogue.zh: 分成兩組，一組是床位，一組是座位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could you read my ticket once more, please?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd ju rid maɪ ˈtɪkɪt wʌns mɔr pliz?/
dialogue.zh: 請你再幫我讀一次車票好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It reads car four, upper bed, night service.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ridz kɑr fɔr ˈʌpər bɛd naɪt ˈsɜrvɪs./
dialogue.zh: 上面寫四號車、上舖、夜間班次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Upper bed means a ladder, then?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌpər bɛd minz ə ˈlædər ðɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 上舖就代表要有梯子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a short one folds flat beside the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ə ʃɔrt wʌn foʊldz flæt bəˈsaɪd ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 是的，一支短梯子收在門旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, I like the high bed near the light.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt aɪ laɪk ðə haɪ bɛd nɪr ðə laɪt./
dialogue.zh: 剛好，我喜歡靠近燈的高床。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Many guests ask for the top one first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɛni ɡɛsts æsk fɔr ðə tɑp wʌn fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 很多乘客都先搶上面那張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the train stopping now at small Dale?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə treɪn ˈstɑpɪŋ naʊ ət smɔl deɪl?/
dialogue.zh: 這班車現在會在戴爾小站停嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it halves here, so stay awake a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt hævz hɪr soʊ steɪ əˈweɪk ə bɪt./
dialogue.zh: 是的，會在這裡分成兩段，先別睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Halves? You mean the back cars unhook?
dialogue.phonetic: /hævz ju min ðə bæk kɑrz ʌnˈhʊk?/
dialogue.zh: 分成兩段？你是說後面的車廂會脫開？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, six and seven go on ahead.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli sɪks ænd ˈsɛvən ɡoʊ ɑn əˈhɛd./
dialogue.zh: 正是，六號和七號會繼續往前。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, does my room four stay or move?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt dʌz maɪ rum fɔr steɪ ɔr muv?/
dialogue.zh: 等等，我的四號車廂是留下還是走？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check, do not unhook your bag yet.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi tʃɛk du nɑt ʌnˈhʊk jɔr bæɡ jɛt./
dialogue.zh: 讓我查一下，先別把行李拿下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lights just blinked and people laughed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə laɪts dʒʌst blɪŋkt ænd ˈpipəl læft./
dialogue.zh: 燈光剛剛閃了一下，大家都笑了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the air line letting go.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ði ɛr laɪn ˈlɛtɪŋ ɡoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 那是氣管連結鬆開的聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, sir, did cars six leave already?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuːz mi sɜrd dɪd kɑrz sɪks liv ɔlˈrɛdi?/
dialogue.zh: 請問先生，六號七號車已經走了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the seats, the beds are still here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ðə sits ðə bɛdz ɑr stɪl hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 只走座位車，寢車還在。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So my room stays with cars one through four?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ maɪ rum steɪz wɪð kɑrz wʌn θru fɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 所以我的房間還在一到四號車那一頭？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better ask the guard, he holds the list.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛtər æsk ðə ɡɑrd hi hoʊldz ðə lɪst./
dialogue.zh: 最好去問車長，名單在他那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who is the guard with the red armband?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu ɪz ðə ɡɑrd wɪð ðə rɛd ˈɑrmbænd?/
dialogue.zh: 戴紅袖標的車長是哪一位？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The tall man counting doors at the end.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tɔl mæn ˈkaʊntɪŋ dɔrz ət ði ɛnd./
dialogue.zh: 就是車尾那個在數門的高個男人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I find him in this dark?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ faɪnd hɪm ɪn ðɪs dɑrk?/
dialogue.zh: 這麼黑，我要怎麼找到他？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Follow the blue carpet strip on the floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɑloʊ ðə blu ˈkɑrpɪt strɪp ɑn ðə flɔr./
dialogue.zh: 跟著地上那條藍色地毯走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I passed him twice, he walks very fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ pæst hɪm twaɪs hi wɔks ˈvɛri fæst./
dialogue.zh: 我錯過他兩次，他走得好快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the room by the small sink door.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ðə rum baɪ ðə smɔl sɪŋk dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 去洗手池那間房看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sir, my bed room is listed car four.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɜrd maɪ bɛd rum ɪz ˈlɪstəd kɑr fɔr./
dialogue.zh: 先生，我的床位登記在四號車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your car is four, and four is behind you.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr kɑr ɪz fɔr ænd fɔr ɪz bɪˈhaɪnd ju./
dialogue.zh: 你的車廂是四號，四號就在你後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Behind? Then all my walking was wrong.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈhaɪnd ðɛn ɔl maɪ ˈwɔkɪŋ wʌz rɔŋ./
dialogue.zh: 後面？那我剛剛都走錯方向了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, this end is hard to find at night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑri ðɪs ɛnd ɪz hɑrd tu faɪnd ət naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 不怪你，這頭在天黑時很難找。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my car four past carriage eight?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz maɪ kɑr fɔr pæst ˈkærɪdʒ eɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我的四號車在八節車廂後面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, four sits right behind the small dining car.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ fɔr sɪts raɪt bɪˈhaɪnd ðə smɔl ˈdaɪnɪŋ kɑr./
dialogue.zh: 不是，四號就在小餐車後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many doors do I count from here?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni dɔrz du aɪ kaʊnt frʌm hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 從這裡開始我要數幾道門？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pass five doors, then one more is four.
dialogue.phonetic: /pæs faɪv dɔrz ðɛn wʌn mɔr ɪz fɔr./
dialogue.zh: 過了五道門，再一道就是四號車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My legs are tired from all this walking.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ lɛɡz ɑr ˈtaɪərd frʌm ɔl ðɪs ˈwɔkɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 走這麼久，我的腿都酸了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit one minute by the mirror, I will wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt wʌn ˈmɪnɪt baɪ ðə ˈmɪrər aɪ wɪl weɪt./
dialogue.zh: 在鏡子邊坐一分鐘，我等你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A girl in blue socks just pointed down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ɡɜrl ɪn blu sɑks dʒʌst ˈpɔɪntəd daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 一個穿藍襪的女生剛剛往下指。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She works nights, so ask her about four.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi wɜrks naɪts soʊ æsk hɜr əˈbaʊt fɔr./
dialogue.zh: 她上夜班，問她四號車就對了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Miss, is car four that way?
dialogue.phonetic: /mɪs ɪz kɑr fɔr ðæt weɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 小姐，四號車是這個方向嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, down and left, past the hot water box.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs daʊn ænd lɛft pæst ðə hɑt ˈwɔtər bɑks./
dialogue.zh: 對，往前再左轉，經過熱水機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you, your hands are full too, miss.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju jɔr hændz ɑr fʊl tu mɪs./
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你，你自己也忙著呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No trouble, trains were my childhood home.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈtrʌbəl treɪnz wɜr maɪ ˈtʃaɪldhʊd hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 不麻煩，我從小就在火車長大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here is car four, the plate says four.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪz kɑr fɔr ðə pleɪt sɛz fɔr./
dialogue.zh: 這裡就是四號車，牌子上寫四。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And your room is the fourth door inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd jɔr rum ɪz ðə fɔrθ dɔr ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 你的房間是進去後的第四道門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Doors nine, ten, eleven, then mine is twelve?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɔrz naɪn tɛn ɪˈlɛvən ðɛn maɪn ɪz twɛlv?/
dialogue.zh: 九、十、十一，然後我的是十二？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Correct, room twelve, the one with the brass handle.
dialogue.phonetic: /kəˈrɛkt rum twɛlv ðə wʌn wɪð ðə bræs ˈhændəl./
dialogue.zh: 正確，十二號房，把手是黃銅色那間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My old ticket said room two, not twelve.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ oʊld ˈtɪkɪt sɛd rum tu nɑt twɛlv./
dialogue.zh: 我舊票上寫的是二號房，不是十二號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They moved beds once, the car never changed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ muvd bɛdz wʌns ðə kɑr ˈnɛvər tʃeɪndʒd./
dialogue.zh: 床位動過一次，車廂並沒有換。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I still share the room with the lady?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ aɪ stɪl ʃɛr ðə rum wɪð ðə ˈleɪdi?/
dialogue.zh: 所以我還是跟那位女士共用房間？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, she moved her bag in ahead of you.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ʃi muvd hɜr bæɡ ɪn əˈhɛd ʌv ju./
dialogue.zh: 是的，她比你早一點把行李放進來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, I like a roommate who is quiet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪ laɪk ə ˈrumˌmeɪt hu ɪz ˈkwaɪət./
dialogue.zh: 很好，我喜歡安靜的室友。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She asked me to keep the lamp low.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi æskt mi tə kip ðə læmp loʊ/
dialogue.zh: 她請我把燈光調暗一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you stamp my card for car four?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju stæmp maɪ kɑrd fɔr kɑr fɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 可以在我的卡上蓋四號車的章嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, now the door opens with that same card.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn naʊ ðə dɔr ˈoʊpənz wɪð ðæt seɪm kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 好了，現在用同一張卡就能開門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lock is a small screen, not a key.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə lɑk ɪz ə smɔl skrin nɑt ə ki./
dialogue.zh: 鎖是一塊小螢幕，不是鑰匙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold your card flat and listen for one click.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld jɔr kɑrd flæt ænd ˈlɪsən fɔr wʌn klɪk./
dialogue.zh: 把卡平貼上去，聽到一聲喀就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One click, and the whole door slid back.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn klɪk ænd ðə hoʊl dɔr slɪd bæk./
dialogue.zh: 喀一聲，整道門就滑開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See, your room looks just like the first one.
dialogue.phonetic: /si jɔr rum lʊks dʒʌst laɪk ðə fɜrst wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 你看，這間跟原本那間長得一模一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only the wall color is darker in here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ðə wɔl ˈkʌlər ɪz ˈdɑrkər ɪn hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 只有牆的顏色比較深。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The rooms look alike, the bed is the same.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə rumz lʊk əˈlaɪk ðə bɛd ɪz ðə seɪm./
dialogue.zh: 兩間房幾乎一樣，床也完全相同。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did my big bag come along with me?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd maɪ bɪɡ bæɡ kʌm əˈlɔŋ wɪð mi?/
dialogue.zh: 我的大行李跟著我過來了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two porters carried it, look beside the mirror.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈpɔrtərz ˈkærid ɪt lʊk bəˈsaɪd ðə ˈmɪrər./
dialogue.zh: 兩個搬運工抬來的，在鏡子旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh good, my warm coat is inside that bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ɡʊd maɪ wɔrm koʊt ɪz ɪnˈsaɪd ðæt bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我的厚外套在裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hang it on the hook behind the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæŋ ɪt ɑn ðə hʊk bɪˈhaɪnd ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 掛在門後那個鉤子上就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the washroom down this hall or the next?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈwɑʃrum daʊn ðɪs hɔl ɔr ðə nɛkst?/
dialogue.zh: 洗手間是這條走廊還是下一條？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next hall, two steps past the emergency shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst hɔl tu stɛps pæst ði ɪˈmɜrdʒənsi ʃɛlf./
dialogue.zh: 下一條，過了緊急物品架兩個台階。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time do the staff wake the sleepers?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt taɪm du ðə stæf weɪk ðə ˈslipərz?/
dialogue.zh: 工作人員幾點會叫醒臥舖乘客？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six forty, unless you ask for an earlier call.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ˈfɔrti ʌnˈlɛs ju æsk fɔr ən ˈɜrliər kɔl./
dialogue.zh: 六點四十，除非你要更早的叫醒服務。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please write six ten on my door card.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz raɪt sɪks tɛn ɑn maɪ dɔr kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 請在我的門卡上寫六點十分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, and I will knock twice myself.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn ænd aɪ wɪl nɑk twaɪs maɪˈsɛlf./
dialogue.zh: 寫好了，我會親自敲兩下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is breakfast in this car too, or farther on?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ˈbrɛkfəst ɪn ðɪs kɑr tu ɔr ˈfɑrðər ɑn?/
dialogue.zh: 早餐也在這節車嗎，還是更前面？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cart comes to every room, so stay put.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kɑrt kʌmz tu ˈɛvri rum soʊ steɪ pʊt./
dialogue.zh: 餐車會推到每個房門，你不用走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That helps, I hate hunting doors at dawn.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt hɛlps aɪ heɪt ˈhʌntɪŋ dɔrz ət dɔn./
dialogue.zh: 那太好了，我不喜歡天亮時找門。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dawn light is pretty here, the river glows.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɔn laɪt ɪz ˈprɪti hɪr ðə ˈrɪvər ɡloʊz./
dialogue.zh: 這裡天亮的河面會發光，很美。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My friend slept in car five last winter.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ frɛnd slɛpt ɪn kɑr faɪv læst ˈwɪntər/
dialogue.zh: 我朋友去年冬天睡在五號車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five is seats only now, they took beds out.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ɪz sits ˈoʊnli naʊ ðeɪ tʊk bɛdz aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 五號車現在只有座位，床位都拆掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So this train changes its shape every year?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðɪs treɪn ˈtʃeɪndʒɪz ɪts ʃeɪp ˈɛvri jɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 所以這班車每年都換組合？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, remember to read the card twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs rɪˈmɛmbər tu rid ðə kɑrd twaɪs./
dialogue.zh: 對，所以記得要把票看兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where does the guard keep the night list?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr dʌz ðə ɡɑrd kip ðə naɪt lɪst?/
dialogue.zh: 車長把夜間名單放在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Room nine, right by the small dining door.
dialogue.phonetic: /rum naɪn raɪt baɪ ðə smɔl ˈdaɪnɪŋ dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 九號房，就在小餐車門旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you again for walking me back here.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju əˈɡɛn fɔr ˈwɔkɪŋ mi bæk hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 再一次謝謝你陪我走回這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No trouble, and sleep well in car four.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈtrʌbəl ænd slip wɛl ɪn kɑr fɔr./
dialogue.zh: 不麻煩，祝你在四號車睡得好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hope the wheels sing a soft tune.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hoʊp ðə wilz sɪŋ ə sɔft tun./
dialogue.zh: 我希望車輪今晚唱得輕一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They always do past the first hill.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ˈɔlweɪz du pæst ðə fɜrst hɪl./
dialogue.zh: 過了第一座山丘，它們向來很輕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We are in, let me shut the door now.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ɑr ɪn lɛt mi ʃʌt ðə dɔr naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我們都進來了，我先把門關上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First, leave the card on the little hook.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst liv ðə kɑrd ɑn ðə ˈlɪtəl hʊk./
dialogue.zh: 先別忙，門卡掛在那個小鉤子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lady below me is asleep already.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈleɪdi bɪˈloʊ mi ɪz əˈslip ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 我下面那鋪的女士已經睡著了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Quiet now, she sleeps very deep tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkwaɪət naʊ ʃi slips ˈvɛri dip təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 小聲一點，她今晚睡得很沉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is car four quiet around one in the morning?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz kɑr fɔr ˈkwaɪət əˈraʊnd wʌn ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 夜裡一點前後，四號車會安靜嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, after ten the guard asks for quiet voices.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈæftər tɛn ðə ɡɑrd æskz fɔr ˈkwaɪət ˈvɔɪsɪz./
dialogue.zh: 會，十點以後車長就請大家小聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, then my water goes by the bed edge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt ðɛn maɪ ˈwɔtər ɡoʊz baɪ ði bɛd ɛdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 太好了，那我把水瓶放在床邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The shelf sits above the ladder, it holds one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ʃɛlf sɪts əˈbʌv ðə ˈlædər ɪt hoʊldz wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 架子在梯子上方，只放得下一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which rungs are silver and which one is new?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ rʌŋz ɑr ˈsɪlvər ænd wɪtʃ wʌn ɪz nu?/
dialogue.zh: 哪些橫檔是銀色的，哪一根是新換的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press the shiny ones, they grip your shoe.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɛs ðə ˈʃaɪni wʌnz ðeɪ ɡrɪp jɔr ʃu./
dialogue.zh: 踩有亮的那幾根，它們比較防滑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this ladder locked to the wall at night?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs ˈlædər lɑkt tu ðə wɔl ət naɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 這支梯子晚上要鎖在牆上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It clicks in two slots, feel for them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt klɪks ɪn tu slɑts fil fɔr ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 它會喀一聲卡進兩個槽，用手摸摸看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My bag will not fit under the bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ bæɡ wɪl nɑt fɪt ˈʌndər ðə bɛd./
dialogue.zh: 我的包包塞不到床底下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the space behind the folding seat back.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ðə speɪs bɪˈhaɪnd ðə ˈfoʊldɪŋ sit bæk./
dialogue.zh: 試試摺疊椅背後面那個空間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I hook my bag and hold the rail.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ aɪ hʊk maɪ bæɡ ænd hoʊld ðə reɪl./
dialogue.zh: 所以我把包勾好，再抓欄杆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slowly now, the floor moves when we turn.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsloʊli naʊ ðə flɔr muvz wɛn wi tɜrn./
dialogue.zh: 慢慢來，轉彎時地板會移動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This ladder is longer than the last one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈlædər ɪz ˈlɔŋɡər ðæn ðə læst wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 這個梯子比剛剛那支長。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Seven rungs, I count them every night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛvən rʌŋz aɪ kaʊnt ðɛm ˈɛvri naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 七個橫檔，我每晚都數一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My suitcase is too wide for the rack.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈsutkeɪs ɪz tu waɪd fɔr ðə ræk./
dialogue.zh: 我的行李箱太寬，架子放不下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Big bags ride on the floor by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪɡ bæɡz raɪd ɑn ðə flɔr baɪ ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 大行李就放在門口地板上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I lift the lower bed to make space?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ lɪft ðə ˈloʊər bɛd tu meɪk speɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以把下舖抬起來騰個空間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, only the guard folds that one down.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈoʊnli ðə ɡɑrd foʊldz ðæt wʌn daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 不行，只有車長能把那張摺起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I put my small money pouch?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du aɪ pʊt maɪ smɔl ˈmʌni paʊtʃ?/
dialogue.zh: 我的零錢小包要放哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a locked drawer beside your bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə lɑkt drɔr bəˈsaɪd jɔr bɛd./
dialogue.zh: 你床旁邊有一個會鎖的抽屜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A drawer, good, I hate losing my phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə drɔr ɡʊd aɪ heɪt ˈluzɪŋ maɪ foʊn./
dialogue.zh: 有抽屜就好，我最怕手機不見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put the drawer key on a string, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ðə drɔr ki ɑn ə strɪŋ ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 那就把抽屜鑰匙用繩子掛起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the net above the bed hold a bag?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə nɛt əˈbʌv ðə bɛd hoʊld ə bæɡ?/
dialogue.zh: 床上那個網袋能掛包包嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but clip it tight, the train shakes.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs bʌt klɪp ɪt taɪt ðə treɪn ʃeɪks./
dialogue.zh: 可以，但要夾緊，車會震。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My coat needs a hook, not the floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ koʊt nidz ə hʊk nɑt ðə flɔr./
dialogue.zh: 我的外套需要鉤子，不能擲在地上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two hooks sit inside, behind the curtain.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu hʊks sɪt ɪnˈsaɪd bɪˈhaɪnd ðə ˈkɜrtən./
dialogue.zh: 簾子後面裡面有兩個鉤子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the curtain on a rail or a ring?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈkɜrtən ɑn ə reɪl ɔr ə rɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 簾子是滑軌還是圓環？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small rings, they slide with one hand pull.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl rɪŋz ðeɪ slaɪd wɪð wʌn hænd pʊl./
dialogue.zh: 小圓環，單手拉就能滑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me climb first, my arms are longer.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi klaɪm fɜrst maɪ ɑrmz ɑr ˈlɔŋɡər./
dialogue.zh: 讓我先爬，我手臂比較長。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please wait, my bag is on the step.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz weɪt maɪ bæɡ ɪz ɑn ðə stɛp./
dialogue.zh: 請等一下，我的包還踩在階梯上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The top bed looks low to the roof.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tɑp bɛd lʊks loʊ tu ðə ruf./
dialogue.zh: 上面那張床離車頂好近。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can sit up there, but not stand.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn sɪt ʌp ðɛr bʌt nɑt stænd./
dialogue.zh: 在上面可以坐著，但不能站起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I take my shoes up or leave them?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ teɪk maɪ ʃuz ʌp ɔr liv ðɛm?/
dialogue.zh: 我的鞋子要帶上去還是留下來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave them under the lower bed, safe there.
dialogue.phonetic: /liv ðɛm ˈʌndər ðə ˈloʊər bɛd seɪf ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 留在下舖床下就好，那裡不會被踢到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My slippers are soft, I need grip socks.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈslɪpərz ɑr sɔft aɪ nid ɡrɪp sɑks./
dialogue.zh: 我的拖鞋太軟，我需要防滑襪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The guard keeps spare socks in car one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡɑrd kips spɛr sɑks ɪn kɑr wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 備用襪在一號車那位車長那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I climb down in the dark?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ klaɪm daʊn ɪn ðə dɑrk?/
dialogue.zh: 黑黑的時候我要怎麼爬下來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Feel for the first rung with your toe.
dialogue.phonetic: /fil fɔr ðə fɜrst rʌŋ wɪð jɔr toʊ./
dialogue.zh: 先用腳趾去碰最下面那一根。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This bag strap is caught on the hook.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs bæɡ stræp ɪz kɔt ɑn ðə hʊk./
dialogue.zh: 包帶被鉤子卡住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lift the strap up, then turn it left.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɪft ðə stræp ʌp ðɛn tɜrn ɪt lɛft./
dialogue.zh: 把帶子往上提，再往左轉就開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the ladder wet? My hand slid once.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈlædər wɛt maɪ hænd slɪd wʌns?/
dialogue.zh: 梯子濕了嗎？我的手剛剛滑了一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No water there, maybe your sleeve is oily.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈwɔtər ðɛr ˈmeɪbi jɔr sliv ɪz ˈɔɪli./
dialogue.zh: 梯子上沒水，可能是你的袖口有油。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry, let me wipe it with my cloth.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑri lɛt mi waɪp ɪt wɪð maɪ klɔθ./
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，讓我用布擦一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, the rungs feel dry again now.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju ðə rʌŋz fil draɪ əˈɡɛn naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，現在橫檔摸起來是乾的了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can the upper lamp bend toward my bed?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ði ˈʌpər læmp bɛnd təˈwɔrd maɪ bɛd?/
dialogue.zh: 上面那盞燈能朝我的床傾過來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twist it gently, the arm is stiff.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɪst ɪt ˈdʒɛntli ði ɑrm ɪz stɪf./
dialogue.zh: 輕輕轉，燈臂有點硬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should I put my empty water cup?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ʃʊd aɪ pʊt maɪ ˈɛmpti ˈwɔtər kʌp?/
dialogue.zh: 我空了的水杯要放哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the small tray beside the mirror.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ðə smɔl treɪ bəˈsaɪd ðə ˈmɪrər./
dialogue.zh: 放鏡子旁邊那個小托盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the mirror glass or just shiny metal?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈmɪrər ɡlæs ɔr dʒʌst ˈʃaɪni ˈmɛtəl?/
dialogue.zh: 鏡子是真的玻璃還是亮金屬？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Real glass, so hold your bag when you pass.
dialogue.phonetic: /ril ɡlæs soʊ hoʊld jɔr bæɡ wɛn ju pæs./
dialogue.zh: 真玻璃，所以經過時把包拿好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The train is tilting, my bag slid down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə treɪn ɪz ˈtɪltɪŋ maɪ bæɡ slɪd daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 車身傾了一下，我的包滑下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Push it deep under the seat, it stops there.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊʃ ɪt dip ˈʌndər ðə sit ɪt stɑps ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 把它塞進座位底下最深處就不動了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to fold the seat for sleep?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tu foʊld ðə sit fɔr slip?/
dialogue.zh: 睡覺前我要自己把座位摺起來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The guard does that before lights out, not you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡɑrd dʌz ðæt bɪˈfɔr laɪts aʊt nɑt ju./
dialogue.zh: 熄燈前車長會來摺，不用你動手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This pillow bag is puffy, where does it go?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈpɪloʊ bæɡ ɪz ˈpʌfi wɛr dʌz ɪt ɡoʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 這包枕頭鼓鼓的，要放哪邊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Squeeze the air out, then it fits the shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /skwiz ði ɛr aʊt ðɛn ɪt fɪts ðə ʃɛlf./
dialogue.zh: 把空氣壓出來，就塞得進架子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Squeeze like this? My arms are shaking now.
dialogue.phonetic: /skwiz laɪk ðɪs maɪ ɑrmz ɑr ˈʃeɪkɪŋ naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 這樣壓嗎？我手臂都在抖了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, close the valve while you press down.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs kloʊz ðə vælw waɪl ju prɛs daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 對，往下壓的同時把氣閥關緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my passport safe in that locked drawer?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz maɪ ˈpæspɔrt seɪf ɪn ðæt lɑkt drɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 我的護照放在那個鎖著的抽屜裡安全嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and keep the key string on your neck.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd kip ðə ki strɪŋ ɑn jɔr nɛk./
dialogue.zh: 安全的，鑰匙繩就掛在你脖子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I borrow the little brush for dust?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ˈbɑroʊ ðə ˈlɪtəl brʌʃ fɔr dʌst?/
dialogue.zh: 可以借我那個除塵小刷嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It lives in the hall cupboard, second shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt lɪvz ɪn ðə hɔl ˈkʌbərd ˈsɛkənd ʃɛlf./
dialogue.zh: 在走廊那櫃子第二層。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My bag is finally up, the rack is full.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ bæɡ ɪz ˈfaɪnəli ʌp ðə ræk ɪz fʊl./
dialogue.zh: 我的包終於放上去了，架子滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, nothing falls on your face at each curve.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈnʌθɪŋ fɔlz ɑn jɔr feɪs ət itʃ kɜrv./
dialogue.zh: 很好，轉彎時就不會有東西掉到你臉上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the bags get stolen at night stops?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðə bæɡz ɡɛt ˈstolən ət naɪt stɑps?/
dialogue.zh: 夜裡小站停車時行李會被拿走嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rare, but lock your room when you leave.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɛr bʌt lɑk jɔr rum wɛn ju liv./
dialogue.zh: 很少，但你離開時還是要鎖門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This ladder makes a ring when I step.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈlædər meɪks ə rɪŋ wɛn aɪ stɛp./
dialogue.zh: 我一踩，梯子就叮噹響。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press your foot flat, the loose part is fixed.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɛs jɔr fʊt flæt ðə lus pɑrt ɪz fɪkst./
dialogue.zh: 整隻腳掌踩平，鬆的那片我已經固定好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the top bed made for me already?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə tɑp bɛd meɪd fɔr mi ɔlˈrɛdi?/
dialogue.zh: 上面那張床已經幫我鋪好了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, the linen comes at nine forty.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt jɛt ðə ˈlɪnən kʌmz ət naɪn ˈfɔrti./
dialogue.zh: 還沒，床單九點四十才送來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I sit and wait on this small seat.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ aɪ sɪt ænd weɪt ɑn ðɪs smɔl sit./
dialogue.zh: 那我就先坐在這個小座位上等。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, here is tea while you rest legs.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs hɪr ɪz ti waɪl ju rɛst lɛɡz./
dialogue.zh: 好，這杯茶給你，先讓腿休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did someone move my blue bag, or not?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ˈsʌmwʌn muv maɪ blu bæɡ ɔr nɑt?/
dialogue.zh: 有人動過我的藍色包嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I set it by the door, see the tag.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ sɛt ɪt baɪ ðə dɔr si ðə tæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 我把它放在門邊，標籤還在。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tag has my name, thank you kindly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tæɡ hæz maɪ neɪm θæŋk ju ˈkaɪndli./
dialogue.zh: 標籤上有我的名字，真是太謝謝你了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Names help a lot when cars get split.
dialogue.phonetic: /neɪmz hɛlp ə lɑt wɛn kɑrz ɡɛt splɪt./
dialogue.zh: 車廂分開時，名字能幫大忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My bag has a wheel that keeps rolling.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ bæɡ hæz ə wil ðæt kips ˈroʊlɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 我的包有一個輪子一直在滾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Flip the wheel lock, a small metal tab.
dialogue.phonetic: /flɪp ðə wil lɑk ə smɔl ˈmɛtəl tæb./
dialogue.zh: 把輪子鎖板扳下來，那是個小金屬片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ah, that stops it, the train can sway.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ ðæt stɑps ɪt ðə treɪn kæn sweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 啊，這樣就不滾了，車還會搖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everything sways here, even the hanging coat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvriθɪŋ sweɪz hɪr ˈivən ðə ˈhæŋɪŋ koʊt./
dialogue.zh: 這裡什麼都會搖，連掛著的外套也是。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the ladder strong enough for two of us?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈlædər strɔŋ ɪˈnʌf fɔr tu ʌv ʌs?/
dialogue.zh: 這梯子夠穩，能讓兩個人一起爬嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One at a time, please, it bends under two.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ət ə taɪm pliz ɪt bɛndz ˈʌndər tu./
dialogue.zh: 一次一位，兩個人同時爬會彎。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can the little lady reach the top shelf?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ðə ˈlɪtəl ˈleɪdi ritʃ ðə tɑp ʃɛlf?/
dialogue.zh: 那位小個子女士拿得到最上面的架子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She stands on the seat, not the ladder rung.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi stændz ɑn ðə sit nɑt ðə ˈlædər rʌŋ./
dialogue.zh: 她踩座位就好，不要去踩梯子橫檔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will help her, my arms are free now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl hɛlp hɜr maɪ ɑrmz ɑr fri naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我來幫她，我的手現在空著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kind of you, she walks slow in her socks.
dialogue.phonetic: /kaɪnd ʌv ju ʃi wɔks sloʊ ɪn hɜr sɑks./
dialogue.zh: 你真好，她穿襪子走路很慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The window shelf holds cups and one small plant.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈwɪndoʊ ʃɛlf hoʊldz kʌps ænd wʌn smɔl plænt./
dialogue.zh: 窗邊架子上有杯子和一個小盆栽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A guest left it, water comes from the hall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ɡɛst lɛft ɪt ˈwɔtər kʌmz frʌm ðə hɔl./
dialogue.zh: 是上一位乘客留下的，水可以在走廊取得。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that safe with the train braking hard?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt seɪf wɪð ðə treɪn ˈbreɪkɪŋ hɑrd?/
dialogue.zh: 車急煞的時候那樣放安全嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It sits in a cup holder, do not worry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt sɪts ɪn ə kʌp ˈhoʊldər du nɑt ˈwɜri./
dialogue.zh: 它放在杯架裡，不用擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My bag is done, now where do I sleep?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ bæɡ ɪz dʌn naʊ wɛr du aɪ slip?/
dialogue.zh: 行李都弄好了，我現在要睡哪邊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Up the ladder, on the clean folded blanket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌp ðə ˈlædər ɑn ðə klin ˈfoʊldɪd ˈblæŋkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 爬梯子上去，那條乾淨毯子已經摺好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bed is narrow, but it looks so soft.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɛd ɪz ˈnæroʊ bʌt ɪt lʊks soʊ sɔft./
dialogue.zh: 床很窄，但看起來好軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Climb in feet first, the pillow waits for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /klaɪm ɪn fit fɜrst ðə ˈpɪloʊ weɪts fɔr ju./
dialogue.zh: 先伸腳上去，枕頭就在那裡等你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I tuck the blanket or just pull it?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ tʌk ðə ˈblæŋkɪt ɔr dʒʌst pʊl ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 毯子要塞好還是隨便拉過來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just pull, loose is fine when the car shakes.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst pʊl lus ɪz faɪn wɛn ðə kɑr ʃeɪks./
dialogue.zh: 拉過來就好，車一震鬆一點反而好睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One last thing, my bag is under the seat.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn læst θɪŋ maɪ bæɡ ɪz ˈʌndər ðə sit./
dialogue.zh: 最後一件事，我的包放在座位下了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, then nothing blocks the ladder for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ðɛn ˈnʌθɪŋ blɑks ðə ˈlædər fɔr mi./
dialogue.zh: 那很好，梯子前面就不會被擋到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The ladder folds back with a small click.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈlædər foʊldz bæk wɪð ə smɔl klɪk./
dialogue.zh: 梯子喀一聲就收回去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, hang it flat, it stops the swing sound.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs hæŋ ɪt flæt ɪt stɑps ðə swɪŋ saʊnd./
dialogue.zh: 對，把它貼平掛好，就不會搖出聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now I am up, and my things are safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ aɪ æm ʌp ænd maɪ θɪŋz ɑr seɪf./
dialogue.zh: 我爬上來了，東西也安好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There, I will dim the hall light first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr aɪ wɪl dɪm ðə hɔl laɪt fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 我先將走廊的燈調暗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the ladder need to stay out all night?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ˈlædər nid tu steɪ aʊt ɔl naɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 梯子整晚都要留著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it out, you need it at morning tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ɪt aʊt ju nid ɪt ət ˈmɔrnɪŋ ti./
dialogue.zh: 留著吧，早上喝茶還要靠它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, where do the clean sheets live?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuːz mi wɛr du ðə klin ʃits lɪv?/
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，乾淨的床單放在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the closet at the end of the hall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ðə ˈklɑsət ət ði ɛnd ʌv ðə hɔl./
dialogue.zh: 在走廊最裡面那個櫃子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that closet open at this late hour?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ˈklɑsət ˈoʊpən ət ðɪs leɪt ˈaʊər?/
dialogue.zh: 這麼晚了，那個櫃子還開著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I have the key, name what you need.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ðə ki neɪm wʌt ju nid./
dialogue.zh: 鑰匙在我這裡，你說要什麼就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One flat sheet and a pillow case, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn flæt ʃit ænd ə ˈpɪloʊ keɪs pliz/
dialogue.zh: 請給我一條床單和一個枕頭套。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two cases, your bed takes both tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈkeɪsɪz jɔr bɛd teɪks boʊθ təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 枕頭套要兩個，你今晚那張用得著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My bed is high, can you lift them up?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ bɛd ɪz haɪ kæn ju lɪft ðɛm ʌp?/
dialogue.zh: 我的床在上面，你可以幫我拿上去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, hand me the ladder and I climb.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ hænd mi ðə ˈlædər ænd aɪ klaɪm./
dialogue.zh: 我來爬，你把梯子遞給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here, take the ladder, it folds very fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr teɪk ðə ˈlædər ɪt foʊldz ˈvɛri fæst./
dialogue.zh: 給，梯子，它一下就摺起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, now hold it steady while I reach.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naʊ hoʊld ɪt ˈstɛdi waɪl aɪ ritʃ./
dialogue.zh: 好，我伸手的時候請扶穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sheets smell like sun and clean soap.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ʃits smɛl laɪk sʌn ænd klin soʊp./
dialogue.zh: 床單有太陽和肥皂的味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They dry in the yard at the town depot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ draɪ ɪn ðə jɑrd ət ðə taʊn ˈdipoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 它們在城裡場站的院子曬乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a blanket too, or only sheets?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə ˈblæŋkɪt tu ɔr ˈoʊnli ʃits?/
dialogue.zh: 也有毯子嗎，還是只有床單？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One wool blanket and a thin cover both.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn wʊl ˈblæŋkɪt ænd ə θɪn ˈkʌvər boʊθ./
dialogue.zh: 一條毛毯和一條薄被都有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is cold up here, can I take two?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz koʊld ʌp hɪr kæn aɪ teɪk tu?/
dialogue.zh: 上面好冷，我可以拿兩條嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the spare stays folded on that shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə spɛr steɪz ˈfoʊldɪd ɑn ðæt ʃɛlf./
dialogue.zh: 可以，備用的摺好放在那個架上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I fit the sheet over the mattress?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ fɪt ðə ʃit ˈoʊvər ðə ˈmætrɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 床單要包在墊子上面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the corners have small elastic bands.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə ˈkɔrnərz hæv smɔl ɪˌlæstɪk bændz./
dialogue.zh: 對，四個角有小小的鬆緊帶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Elastic, good, so it will not slip off.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪˈlæstɪk ɡʊd soʊ ɪt wɪl nɑt slɪp ɔf./
dialogue.zh: 有鬆緊就太好了，就不會滑脫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tuck one side first, then pull the next.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʌk wʌn saɪd fɜrst ðɛn pʊl ðə nɛkst./
dialogue.zh: 先塞一邊，再拉另一邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This side is hard, my back is up there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs saɪd ɪz hɑrd maɪ bæk ɪz ʌp ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 這一邊很難塞，我的背在上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bend your knees on the bed, not the ladder.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛnd jɔr niz ɑn ðə bɛd nɑt ðə ˈlædər./
dialogue.zh: 膝蓋彎在床面上，不要踩梯子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One corner is missing, see, this bare spot.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈkɔrnər ɪz ˈmɪsɪŋ si ðɪs bɛr spɑt./
dialogue.zh: 有一個角沒套到，你看這裡露出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stretch the cloth a bit, the bed is short.
dialogue.phonetic: /strɛtʃ ðə klɔθ ə bɪt ðə bɛd ɪz ʃɔrt./
dialogue.zh: 把布拉一下就好，床比較短。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this sheet for the upper or the lower?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs ʃit fɔr ði ˈʌpər ɔr ðə ˈloʊər?/
dialogue.zh: 這條床單是給上舖還是下舖？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both beds share one size, nine by six.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ bɛdz ʃɛr wʌn saɪz naɪn baɪ sɪks./
dialogue.zh: 兩張床尺寸一樣，九乘以六。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine by six, that fits my narrow bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn baɪ sɪks ðæt fɪts maɪ ˈnæroʊ bɛd./
dialogue.zh: 九乘六，剛剛好我的窄床。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the last inch hides under the wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə læst ɪntʃ haɪdz ˈʌndər ðə wɔl./
dialogue.zh: 對，最後那一吋會藏在牆邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My pillow case has a small hole here.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈpɪloʊ keɪs hæz ə smɔl hoʊl hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 我的枕頭套這裡有個小洞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Swap it, I keep fresh ones in my cart.
dialogue.phonetic: /swɑp ɪt aɪ kip frɛʃ wʌnz ɪn maɪ kɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 換掉吧，我推車裡有新的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your cart is outside, in the hall, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr kɑrt ɪz ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ɪn ðə hɔl raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 你的推車就停在外面走廊，對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It stands by room twelve, near the sink.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt stændz baɪ rum twɛlv nɪr ðə sɪŋk./
dialogue.zh: 停在十二房旁邊，就在洗臉台附近。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I see the extra pillow, the soft one?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ si ði ˈɛkstrə ˈpɪloʊ ðə sɔft wʌn?/
dialogue.zh: 可以讓我看看那個額外的軟枕頭嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, it is flat and filled with small feathers.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪt ɪz flæt ænd fɪld wɪð smɔl ˈfɛðərz./
dialogue.zh: 給，它扁扁的，裡面是小羽毛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Feathers, oh, my nose runs around birds.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɛðərz oʊ maɪ noʊz rʌnz əˈraʊnd bɜrdz./
dialogue.zh: 羽毛？唉，我一碰到鳥就流鼻水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take this foam one, no birds inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ðɪs foʊm wʌn noʊ bɜrdz ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 那拿這個海綿枕，裡面沒有羽毛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Foam is fine, thank you for thinking of that.
dialogue.phonetic: /foʊm ɪz faɪn θæŋk ju fɔr ˈθɪŋkɪŋ ʌv ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 海綿的也不錯，謝謝你想得這麼周到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Many guests ask, so I keep two kinds.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɛni ɡɛsts æsk soʊ aɪ kip tu kaɪndz./
dialogue.zh: 很多客人會問，所以我兩種都帶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the thin cover a quilt or just cloth?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə θɪn ˈkʌvər ə kwɪlt ɔr dʒʌst klɔθ?/
dialogue.zh: 那條薄的是棉被還是單純的布？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Light quilt, two soft layers with air between.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪt kwɪlt tu sɔft ˈleɪərz wɪð ɛr bɪˈtwin./
dialogue.zh: 薄棉被，兩層軟布中間夾著空氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My feet stick out, this quilt is short.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ fit stɪk aʊt ðɪs kwɪlt ɪz ʃɔrt./
dialogue.zh: 我的腳露出來了，這被子太短。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fold your blanket over the foot edge then.
dialogue.phonetic: /foʊld jɔr ˈblæŋkɪt ˈoʊvər ðə fʊt ɛdʒ ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 那把毯子摺起來蓋在腳那端。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the blanket need a cover of its own?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ˈblæŋkɪt nid ə ˈkʌvər ʌv ɪts oʊn?/
dialogue.zh: 毯子需要另外套被套嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it is washed clean before every trip.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ɪt ɪz wɑʃt klin bɪˈfɔr ˈɛvri trɪp./
dialogue.zh: 不用，每次發車前都洗過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I use both, the cold comes through glass.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ juz boʊθ ðə koʊld kʌmz θru ɡlæs./
dialogue.zh: 那我兩條一起蓋，寒氣從窗玻璃透進來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Close the blind tight, that helps more than wool.
dialogue.phonetic: /kloʊz ðə blaɪnd taɪt ðæt hɛlps mɔr ðæn wʊl./
dialogue.zh: 把簾子拉緊，那個比毛毯更有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where does the paper bag go now?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr dʌz ðə ˈpeɪpər bæɡ ɡoʊ naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 那個紙袋現在要放哪？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fold it flat and keep it under the seat.
dialogue.phonetic: /foʊld ɪt flæt ænd kip ɪt ˈʌndər ðə sit./
dialogue.zh: 摺平收在座位下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want the old sheet back at dawn?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju wɑnt ði oʊld ʃit bæk ət dɔn?/
dialogue.zh: 天亮的時候你要把舊床單收回去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, roll it and leave it by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs roʊl ɪt ænd liv ɪt baɪ ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 要的，捲起來放在門邊就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Roll it, not fold, that is easy enough.
dialogue.phonetic: /roʊl ɪt nɑt foʊld ðæt ɪz ˈizi ɪˈnʌf./
dialogue.zh: 捲起來而不是摺，這個我做得來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put the dirty side inside, so it looks clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ðə ˈdɜrti saɪd ɪnˈsaɪd soʊ ɪt lʊks klin./
dialogue.zh: 把髒的那面朝裡，外面看起來就乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The mattress is thin, I feel every joint.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈmætrɪs ɪz θɪn aɪ fil ˈɛvri dʒɔɪnt./
dialogue.zh: 墊子太薄，我每個關節都撐得難受。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can add a pad, one more layer.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn æd ə pæd wʌn mɔr ˈleɪər./
dialogue.zh: 我可以再加一個墊，多一層就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please do, my hips hurt on that hard bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz du maɪ hɪps hɜrt ɑn ðæt hɑrd bɛd./
dialogue.zh: 拜託，我那張硬床弄得我臀部痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, this soft pad fits the lower bed best.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ðɪs sɔft pæd fɪts ðə ˈloʊər bɛd bɛst./
dialogue.zh: 給，這個軟墊最適合下面那張床。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a spare sheet if mine gets wet?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə spɛr ʃit ɪf maɪn ɡɛts wɛt?/
dialogue.zh: 如果我的床單濕了，還有備用的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two spares sit in the closet, always.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu spɛrz sɪt ɪn ðə ˈklɑsət ˈɔlweɪz./
dialogue.zh: 櫃子裡一直放著兩條備用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I need one in the dark hours?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf aɪ nid wʌn ɪn ðə dɑrk ˈaʊərz?/
dialogue.zh: 如果我半夜黑的時候需要怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Knock on my door, room nine, at the start.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑk ɑn maɪ dɔr rum naɪn ət ðə stɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 來敲我的門，九號房，就在最前面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Room nine, I write it on my hand now.
dialogue.phonetic: /rum naɪn aɪ raɪt ɪt ɑn maɪ hænd naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 九號房，我寫在手心上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Or use this card, it stays with your lamp.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔr juz ðɪs kɑrd ɪt steɪz wɪð jɔr læmp./
dialogue.zh: 或者用這張卡，它掛在你的燈旁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This bundle string, what do I do with it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈbʌndəl strɪŋ wʌt du aɪ du wɪð ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 捆床單的這條繩，我要怎麼用？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tie the linen and hang it on that hook.
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪ ðə ˈlɪnən ænd hæŋ ɪt ɑn ðæt hʊk./
dialogue.zh: 綁好換下的床單，掛在那個鉤子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dirty linen on a hook, is that odd?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdɜrti ˈlɪnən ɑn ə hʊk ɪz ðæt ɑd?/
dialogue.zh: 髒床單掛在鉤子上，這樣怪不怪？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Behind the door it hides, no one will see.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈhaɪnd ðə dɔr ɪt haɪdz noʊ wʌn wɪl si./
dialogue.zh: 門一關就擋住了，沒人會看見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I pay for the blanket or the pad?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ peɪ fɔr ðə ˈblæŋkɪt ɔr ðə pæd?/
dialogue.zh: 毯子和墊子要另外收費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing, the night fare holds all of these.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ ðə naɪt fɛr hoʊldz ɔl ʌv ðiz./
dialogue.zh: 都不用，夜間票價已經含了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The night fare, good, my wallet thanks you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə naɪt fɛr ɡʊd maɪ ˈwɑlət θæŋks ju/
dialogue.zh: 含在票價裡，我的錢包謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep now, I will check the sheets at dawn.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip naʊ aɪ wɪl tʃɛk ðə ʃits ət dɔn./
dialogue.zh: 先睡吧，天亮我再來看床單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more question, is there a spare pillow case?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr ˈkwɛstʃən ɪz ðɛr ə spɛr ˈpɪloʊ keɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 再問一件事，有備用的枕頭套嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, two in the basket beside your door.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tu ɪn ðə ˈbæskət bəˈsaɪd jɔr dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 有，你門邊的籃子裡有兩個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The basket has soap too, how kind of you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈbæskət hæz soʊp tu haʊ kaɪnd ʌv ju./
dialogue.zh: 籃子裡還有肥皂，你想真周到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small bar, good for hands and a quick wash.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl bɑr ɡʊd fɔr hændz ænd ə kwɪk wɑʃ./
dialogue.zh: 小小一條，洗手或快速洗臉都足夠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I like that the sheet fits so tight here.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ laɪk ðæt ðə ʃit fɪts soʊ taɪt hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 我喜歡床單在這裡繃得好緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The next guest cannot kick it loose in sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə nɛkst ɡɛst ˈkɑnɑt kɪk ɪt lus ɪn slip./
dialogue.zh: 下一位客人睡著時也踢不鬆它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who made the bed before me, the cleaning crew?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu meɪd ðə bɛd bɪˈfɔr mi ðə ˈklinɪŋ kru?/
dialogue.zh: 在我之前是誰鋪的床，打掃小組嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two women at the depot, they work very fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈwɪmɪn ət ðə ˈdipoʊ ðeɪ wɜrk ˈvɛri fæst./
dialogue.zh: 場站的兩位女士，她們動作很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hear them at five, the hall fills up.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hɪr ðɛm ət faɪv ðə hɔl fɪlz ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 我五點就會聽到她們，走廊會熱鬧起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They take the used linen and bring fresh water.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ teɪk ðə juzd ˈlɪnən ænd brɪŋ frɛʃ ˈwɔtər./
dialogue.zh: 她們收走用過的床單，也補充新水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the top sheet cool on my cold back?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə tɑp ʃit kul ɑn maɪ koʊld bæk?/
dialogue.zh: 最上面那層摸起來會讓我背更冷嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cotton first, so the cold leaves in two minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɑtən fɜrst soʊ ðə koʊld livz ɪn tu ˈmɪnɪts./
dialogue.zh: 棉面朝先是涼的，兩分鐘後就不冷了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hands are cold too, where are warm gloves?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hændz ɑr koʊld tu wɛr ɑr wɔrm ɡlʌvz?/
dialogue.zh: 我的手也冷，保暖手套在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In your bag, I saw them by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn jɔr bæɡ aɪ sɔ ðɛm baɪ ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 在你包包裡，我看見了放在門邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the bed feels a little like home.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə bɛd filz ə ˈlɪtəl laɪk hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 現在這張床有一點像家的感覺了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the goal, sleep deep till morning light.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə ɡoʊl slip dip tɪl ˈmɔrnɪŋ laɪt./
dialogue.zh: 那就是目的，睡沉到天亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I strip the bed before I go?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ strɪp ðə bɛd bɪˈfɔr aɪ ɡoʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我下車前要把床拆開嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, press the bell, the crew does that part.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ prɛs ðə bɛl ðə kru dʌz ðæt pɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 不用，按鈴就好，那部分是我們做的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A bell sits near my pillow, I found it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə bɛl sɪts nɪr maɪ ˈpɪloʊ aɪ faʊnd ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 鈴就在枕頭旁邊，我找到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One tap is enough, not all night.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn tæp ɪz ɪˈnʌf nɑt ɔl naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 按一下就好，不要整晚按。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The blue line on the sheet marks a size?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə blu laɪn ɑn ðə ʃit mɑrks ə saɪz?/
dialogue.zh: 床單上的藍線是代表尺寸嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blue is the long bed, red is short.
dialogue.phonetic: /blu ɪz ðə lɔŋ bɛd rɛd ɪz ʃɔrt./
dialogue.zh: 藍線是長床，紅線是短床。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Red tag, so mine is the short bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɛd tæɡ soʊ maɪn ɪz ðə ʃɔrt bɛd./
dialogue.zh: 紅色標籤，所以我的是短床。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Correct, and the short bed is nearest the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /kəˈrɛkt ænd ðə ʃɔrt bɛd ɪz ˈnɪrɪst ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，短床那張最靠近門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to sign for the fresh linen?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tu saɪn fɔr ðə frɛʃ ˈlɪnən?/
dialogue.zh: 新的床單我要簽收嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing to sign, just say if it works.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ tu saɪn dʒʌst seɪ ɪf ɪt wɜrks./
dialogue.zh: 不用簽，好用就跟我說一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All good, the sheet holds, the pillow is cool.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl ɡʊd ðə ʃit hoʊldz ðə ˈpɪloʊ ɪz kul./
dialogue.zh: 都很好，床單沒脫，枕頭也涼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then rest, the lamp stays on the low mark.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn rɛst ðə læmp steɪz ɑn ðə loʊ mɑrk./
dialogue.zh: 那就休息，燈我留在最暗那一格。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you for the sheets and for the pad.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju fɔr ðə ʃits ænd fɔr ðə pæd./
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你的床單和墊子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There, your bed is made, now go eat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr jɔr bɛd ɪz meɪd naʊ ɡoʊ it./
dialogue.zh: 床鋪好了，你先去吃晚飯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the dinner card still open right now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈdɪnər kɑrd stɪl ˈoʊpən raɪt naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 現在的晚餐菜單還開著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but the galley shuts at ten sharp.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs bʌt ðə ˈɡæli ʃʌts ət tɛn ʃɑrp./
dialogue.zh: 還開，但廚房十點整就關。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I eat in my room, or walk?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ it ɪn maɪ rum ɔr wɔk?/
dialogue.zh: 我能在包廂裡吃，還是一定要走過去？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both work, the cart brings trays to your door.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ wɜrk ðə kɑrt brɪŋz treɪz tu jɔr dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 都可以，推車可以把托盤送到你門口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is on the soup list tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪz ɑn ðə suːp lɪst təˈnaɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 今晚的湯有哪幾種？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pea soup hot, and a clear noodle bowl.
dialogue.phonetic: /pi suːp hɑt ænd ə klɪr ˈnudəl boʊl./
dialogue.zh: 有熱的豌豆湯，還有一碗清麵湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The pea soup, yes, does it come with bread?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pi suːp jɛs dʌz ɪt kʌm wɪθ brɛd?/
dialogue.zh: 豌豆湯要的，會附麵包嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two slices, one soft, one toasted hard.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈsaɪlsɪz wʌn sɔft wʌn ˈtoʊstəd hɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 兩片，一片軟的，一片烤得酥脆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want the toasted one, it holds the butter.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɑnt ðə ˈtoʊstəd wʌn ɪt hoʊldz ðə ˈbʌtər/
dialogue.zh: 我要烤的那片，它托得住奶油。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Butter comes cold in a small paper cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbʌtər kʌmz koʊld ɪn ə smɔl ˈpeɪpər kʌp./
dialogue.zh: 奶油是涼的，裝在小紙杯裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there chicken, or only fish tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ˈtʃɪkən ɔr ˈoʊnli fɪʃ təˈnaɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 今晚有雞肉嗎，還是只有魚？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Chicken with rice, and fish with green beans.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtʃɪkən wɪð raɪs ænd fɪʃ wɪð ɡrin binz./
dialogue.zh: 雞肉配飯，魚配綠豆泥。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Chicken, please, and no green beans on it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtʃɪkən pliz ænd noʊ ɡrin binz ɑn ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我要雞肉，請不要放綠豆泥。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, the beans go in a side cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn ðə binz ɡoʊ ɪn ə saɪd kʌp./
dialogue.zh: 好了，豆泥另外裝小杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What drink is hot, tea or some milk?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt drɪŋk ɪz hɑt ti ɔr sʌm mɪlk?/
dialogue.zh: 熱飲是茶還是牛奶？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both, the milk is warm, the tea is black.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ ðə mɪlk ɪz wɔrm ðə ti ɪz blæk./
dialogue.zh: 都有，牛奶溫的，茶是清茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Black tea, no sugar, and a tall cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /blæk ti noʊ ˈʃʊɡər ænd ə tɔl kʌp./
dialogue.zh: 清茶不加糖，給我高一點的杯子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your cup has a lid so nothing spills.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr kʌp hæz ə lɪd soʊ ˈnʌθɪŋ spɪlz./
dialogue.zh: 你的杯子有蓋，就不會灑出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A lid, good, the train tips at curves.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə lɪd ɡʊd ðə treɪn tɪps ət kɜrvz./
dialogue.zh: 有蓋就好，轉彎時車會傾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set the tray flat, not on your knee.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt ðə treɪ flæt nɑt ɑn jɔr ni./
dialogue.zh: 托盤要放平，不要擱在膝蓋上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I hold the tray up there?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ hoʊld ðə treɪ ʌp ðɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 我在上面那張床要怎麼托住盤子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A board hooks on the wall rail there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə bɔrd hʊks ɑn ðə wɔl reɪl ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 有一塊桌板可以勾在牆上的橫桿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The wall rail, that silver bar by my head?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wɔl reɪl ðæt ˈsɪlvər bɑr baɪ maɪ hɛd?/
dialogue.zh: 牆上的桿，就是我頭邊那根銀色的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one hook each end, the board sits level.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wʌn hʊk itʃ ɛnd ðə bɔrd sɪts ˈlɛvəl./
dialogue.zh: 對，兩端各一個鉤，桌面才會平。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Level, good, my soup needs a level place.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɛvəl ɡʊd maɪ suːp nidz ə ˈlɛvəl pleɪs./
dialogue.zh: 要平的才好，我的湯需要平的位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I bring it up when you have the board.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ brɪŋ ɪt ʌp wɛn ju hæv ðə bɔrd./
dialogue.zh: 你把桌板架好，我就端上來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now it is on, feel, it holds my weight.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ɪt ɪz ɑn fil ɪt hoʊldz maɪ weɪt./
dialogue.zh: 架上了，你摸摸，它撐得住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, then I climb and set the tray down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ðɛn aɪ klaɪm ænd sɛt ðə treɪ daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 好，那我爬上去把托盤放下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You climb the ladder with a full tray?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju klaɪm ðə ˈlædər wɪð ə fʊl treɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 你要端著滿托盤爬梯子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slowly, one hand free, the cup stays closed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsloʊli wʌn hænd fri ðə kʌp steɪz kloʊzd./
dialogue.zh: 慢慢來，一手空著，杯子蓋著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here is the soup, and it is so hot.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪz ðə suːp ænd ɪt ɪz soʊ hɑt./
dialogue.zh: 端來了，湯還熱得冒煙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait one minute, the bowl cools fast now.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt wʌn ˈmɪnɪt ðə boʊl kuls fæst naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 等一分鐘，碗現在涼得很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bowl is heavy, let me hold both sides.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə boʊl ɪz ˈhɛvi lɛt mi hoʊld boʊθ saɪdz./
dialogue.zh: 碗好重，讓我扶兩邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, grab the rim, cloth under your hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɡræb ðə rɪm klɔθ ˈʌndər jɔr hænd./
dialogue.zh: 對，抓碗緣，手底下墊布。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My napkin is still folded in the pack.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈnæpkɪn ɪz stɪl ˈfoʊldɪd ɪn ðə pæk./
dialogue.zh: 我的餐巾紙還摺在包裡沒拿出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use mine, here, two clean squares on the tray.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz maɪn hɪr tu klin skwɛrz ɑn ðə treɪ./
dialogue.zh: 用我的，這裡，托盤上有兩張方巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you, the spoon is small, is that mine?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju ðə spun ɪz smɔl ɪz ðæt maɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，這把湯匙好小，是給我的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The short one is soup, the long is tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ʃɔrt wʌn ɪz suːp ðə lɔŋ ɪz ti./
dialogue.zh: 短的是喝湯，長的是攪茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pepper or salt, which do people take here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɛpər ɔr sɔlt wɪtʃ du ˈpipəl teɪk hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 這裡大家會加胡椒還是鹽？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both sit in small jars at the cart edge.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ sɪt ɪn smɔl dʒɑrz ət ðə kɑrt ɛdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 兩樣都裝在小罐裡，放在推車邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just pepper, and one shake, my nose itches.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ˈpɛpər ænd wʌn ʃeɪk maɪ noʊz ˈɪtʃɪz./
dialogue.zh: 只要胡椒，搖一下就夠，我鼻子會過敏。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One shake only, the jar is very full.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ʃeɪk ˈoʊnli ðə dʒɑr ɪz ˈvɛri fʊl./
dialogue.zh: 只搖一下，這罐裝得滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The chicken rice smells so good up here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈtʃɪkən raɪs smɛlz soʊ ɡʊd ʌp hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 雞肉飯在上面聞起來好香。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lady below asked for the same dish.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈleɪdi bɪˈloʊ æskt fɔr ðə seɪm dɪʃ./
dialogue.zh: 下面那位女士點了同一道菜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is she sharing a table with you down there?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ʃi ˈʃɛrɪŋ ə ˈteɪbəl wɪð ju daʊn ðɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 她在下面跟別人共桌嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, her board is on her own lap.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ hɜr bɔrd ɪz ɑn hɜr oʊn læp./
dialogue.zh: 不是，她的桌板擱在自己腿上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I pass her the extra bread slice?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ pæs hɜr ði ˈɛkstrə brɛd slaɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以把多出來那片麵包遞給她嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, lean over slow, the ladder is short.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs lin ˈoʊvər sloʊ ðə ˈlædər ɪz ʃɔrt./
dialogue.zh: 可以，慢慢傾身，梯子不長。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here you are, ma'am, one more bread slice.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ju ɑr mæm wʌn mɔr brɛd slaɪs./
dialogue.zh: 給您，女士，多一片麵包。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, and how is the soup up there?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju ænd haʊ ɪz ðə suːp ʌp ðɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，上面的湯味道如何？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warm and thick, the best thing on this train.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm ænd θɪk ðə bɛst θɪŋ ɑn ðɪs treɪn./
dialogue.zh: 又熱又濃，是這班車上最好的一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, pea soup is our last hot dish tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd pi suːp ɪz ˈaʊər læst hɑt dɪʃ təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 那好，豌豆湯是今晚最後一道熱菜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there fruit left, or only those small cookies?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr frut lɛft ɔr ˈoʊnli ðoz smɔl ˈkʊkiz?/
dialogue.zh: 還有水果嗎，還是只有小餅乾？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One apple left, I cut it for two.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈæpəl lɛft aɪ kʌt ɪt fɔr tu./
dialogue.zh: 剩一顆蘋果，我切給兩個人吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cut it here, my knife is in my bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌt ɪt hɪr maɪ naɪf ɪz ɪn maɪ bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 請在這裡切，我的刀收在包裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, half for you, half for the lady.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn hæf fɔr ju hæf fɔr ðə ˈleɪdi./
dialogue.zh: 切好了，一半給你，一半給女士。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The half you gave her was sweet, she said.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hæf ju ɡeɪv hɜr wʌz swit ʃi sɛd./
dialogue.zh: 她說她那半顆比較甜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She gave you the sweet half back, look.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ɡeɪv ju ðə swit hæf bæk lʊk./
dialogue.zh: 她把她那半甜的換給你了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, kind people, I will eat this slow.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ kaɪnd ˈpipəl aɪ wɪl it ðɪs sloʊ./
dialogue.zh: 這些人真親切，我要慢慢吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eat fast now, the tray comes back at ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /it fæst naʊ ðə treɪ kʌmz bæk ət tɛn./
dialogue.zh: 現在快點吃，十點要收托盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten already? I finished only one plate.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ɔlˈrɛdi aɪ ˈfɪnɪʃt ˈoʊnli wʌn pleɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 十點了？我才吃完一個盤子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cart moves on, your soup cup can wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kɑrt muvz ɑn jɔr suːp kʌp kæn weɪt./
dialogue.zh: 推車要往前走了，你的湯杯可以留著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I keep the cup, my throat gets dry?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ kip ðə kʌp maɪ θroʊt ɡɛts draɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 這個杯子我可以留著嗎？喉嚨會乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it stays yours all night, no charge.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt steɪz jɔrz ɔl naɪt noʊ tʃɑrdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 可以，整晚歸你用，不收費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No charge, good, my coins have traveled far.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ tʃɑrdʒ ɡʊd maɪ kɔɪnz hæv ˈtrævəld fɑr./
dialogue.zh: 不收費真好，我的銅板已經走了很遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep them, breakfast in the morning is free.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ðɛm ˈbrɛkfəst ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ ɪz fri./
dialogue.zh: 收著吧，明早的早餐是免費的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then my wallet can rest till we arrive.
