dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn maɪ ˈwɑlət kæn rɛst tɪl wi əˈraɪv./
dialogue.zh: 那我的錢包可以休息到下車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The coffee cart starts at six, sharp.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkɔfi kɑrt stɑrts ət sɪks ʃɑrp./
dialogue.zh: 咖啡推車六點整開始走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six, so I set my phone by the pillow.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks soʊ aɪ sɛt maɪ foʊn baɪ ðə ˈpɪloʊ./
dialogue.zh: 六點，那我把手機放在枕頭邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do that, the hall lamp wakes at five forty.
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðæt ðə hɔl læmp weɪks ət faɪv ˈfɔrti./
dialogue.zh: 就這樣做，走廊燈五點四十就會亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bring back the tray now, or later a bit?
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ bæk ðə treɪ naʊ ɔr ˈleɪtər ə bɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 現在就收托盤，還是再等一下？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave it on the board, I come at ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /liv ɪt ɑn ðə bɔrd aɪ kʌm ət tɛn./
dialogue.zh: 先放在桌板上，我十點來收。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One crumb fell on my sheet, sorry about that.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn krʌm fɛl ɑn maɪ ʃit ˈsɑri əˈbaʊt ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 有一小塊麵包屑掉在床單上，不好意思。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Brush it off, the sheet is washed anyway.
dialogue.phonetic: /brʌʃ ɪt ɔf ðə ʃit ɪz wɑʃt ˈɛniˌweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 拍一拍就好，床單本來就要洗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A little broom, do you carry one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪtəl brum du ju ˈkæri wʌn?/
dialogue.zh: 有小掃把嗎，你們會帶一支嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In my cart, blue handle, I fetch it now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn maɪ kɑrt blu ˈhændəl aɪ fɛtʃ ɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我車上有，藍色把手，我去拿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You have answers for everything on this train.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju hæv ˈænsərz fɔr ˈɛvriθɪŋ ɑn ðɪs treɪn./
dialogue.zh: 這班車上你什麼都知道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two years of nights, I know every room.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu jɪrz ʌv naɪts aɪ noʊ ˈɛvri rum./
dialogue.zh: 跑了兩年夜班，每間房我都熟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The rice was warm, the tea helped my throat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə raɪs wʌz wɔrm ðə ti hɛlpt maɪ θroʊt./
dialogue.zh: 飯是熱的，茶也讓喉嚨舒服多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is what we want, a calm warm belly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz wʌt wi wɑnt ə kɑm wɔrm ˈbɛli./
dialogue.zh: 我們要的就是這個，肚子暖和平靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I must clean my teeth, where is the sink?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ mʌst klin maɪ θiːθ wɛr ɪz ðə sɪŋk?/
dialogue.zh: 我得刷牙，洗臉台在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two steps out, the tall tap gives warm water.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu stɛps aʊt ðə tɔl tæp ɡɪvz wɔrm ˈwɔtər./
dialogue.zh: 出去兩步，那個高水龍頭出熱水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warm water at night is a small gift.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm ˈwɔtər ət naɪt ɪz ə smɔl ɡɪft./
dialogue.zh: 夜裡有熱水就是小禮物。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cup by it is for rinsing, use it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kʌp baɪ ɪt ɪz fɔr ˈrɪnsɪŋ juz ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 旁邊那個杯子是漱口的，儘管用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My toothbrush is in the drawer, I found it.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈtuːθbrʌʃ ɪz ɪn ðə drɔr aɪ faʊnd ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我的牙刷在抽屜裡，找到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, brush slow, the whistle blows at one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd brʌʃ sloʊ ðə ˈwɪsəl bloʊz ət wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 好，慢慢刷，凌晨一點會鳴笛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing, did the bread cost extra?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr θɪŋ dɪd ðə brɛd kɔst ˈɛkstrə?/
dialogue.zh: 還有一件事，麵包要另外加錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No cost, the night fare holds the meal.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ kɔst ðə naɪt fɛr hoʊldz ðə mil./
dialogue.zh: 不用，夜間票價已含這餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The cup, the pad, all in one fare.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kʌp ðə pæd ɔl ɪn wʌn fɛr./
dialogue.zh: 杯子、墊子，都在同一個票價裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, paper tickets on trains hold surprises.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈpeɪpər ˈtɪkɪts ɑn treɪnz hoʊld sərˈpraɪzɪz./
dialogue.zh: 是啊，火車上的紙票常藏著驚喜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I saved the receipt card, it lists the meal.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ seɪvd ðə rɪˈsit kɑrd ɪt lɪsts ðə mil./
dialogue.zh: 我把收據卡留著了，上面列了這餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it, the morning tea needs that card.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ɪt ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ ti nidz ðæt kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 收好，早茶也要查那張卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tray is empty now, my board comes down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə treɪ ɪz ˈɛmpti naʊ maɪ bɔrd kʌmz daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 托盤空了，我的桌板要收下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Unhook one side first, it swings if pulled.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌnˈhʊk wʌn saɪd fɜrst ɪt swɪŋz ɪf pʊld./
dialogue.zh: 先卸一邊的鉤，硬拉會晃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Board down, tray on the cart, all done.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɔrd daʊn treɪ ɑn ðə kɑrt ɔl dʌn./
dialogue.zh: 桌板收好了，托盤也放上推車了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, the cart goes to car nine now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt ðə kɑrt ɡoʊz tu kɑr naɪn naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 太好了，推車現在往九號車去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Car nine, so the galley sleeps there too.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑr naɪn soʊ ðə ˈɡæli slips ðɛr tu./
dialogue.zh: 九號車，廚房也在那邊休息了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They rest in turns, one keeps the coffee warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ rɛst ɪn tɜrnz wʌn kips ðə ˈkɔfi wɔrm./
dialogue.zh: 他們輪流休息，有人顧著咖啡熱度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, then I climb up and close my eyes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ðɛn aɪ klaɪm ʌp ænd kloʊz maɪ aɪz./
dialogue.zh: 好，那我爬上床闔眼睛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep softly, the night train carries you.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip ˈsɔftli ðə naɪt treɪn ˈkæriz ju./
dialogue.zh: 安心睡，夜間火車會穩穩載你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What did that speaker say about the lights?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt dɪd ðæt ˈspikər seɪ əˈbaʊt ðə laɪts?/
dialogue.zh: 那個廣播剛剛說了燈光什麼事？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Main lights out at ten, small lamps stay.
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪn laɪts aʊt ət tɛn smɔl læmps steɪ./
dialogue.zh: 主燈十點熄掉，小燈還留著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So soon, my book is only half done.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ sun maɪ bʊk ɪz ˈoʊnli hæf dʌn./
dialogue.zh: 這麼快，我的書才看了一半。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the tiny lamp, it lights one page.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðə ˈtaɪni læmp ɪt laɪts wʌn peɪdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 用那個小燈就好，只照一頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is that tiny lamp on my bed?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪz ðæt ˈtaɪni læmp ɑn maɪ bɛd?/
dialogue.zh: 我床上那個小燈在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Left of your pillow, a bendy silver neck.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛft ʌv jɔr ˈpɪloʊ ə ˈbɛndi ˈsɪlvər nɛk./
dialogue.zh: 枕頭左邊，一根可彎的銀色燈頸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bendy neck, found it, tap once to wake.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛndi nɛk faʊnd ɪt tæp wʌns tu weɪk./
dialogue.zh: 可彎的，找到了，敲一下就會亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tap twice for soft, three for a bright beam.
dialogue.phonetic: /tæp twaɪs fɔr sɔft θri fɔr ə braɪt bim./
dialogue.zh: 敲兩下微亮，三下才全亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Soft is enough, my eyes are tired already.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔft ɪz ɪˈnʌf maɪ aɪz ɑr ˈtaɪərd ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 微亮就夠了，我的眼睛已經很累。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The big lights die at ten sharp now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɪɡ laɪts daɪ ət tɛn ʃɑrp naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 大燈現在十點整一定會關。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everyone stood up when the hall went dark.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvriwʌn stʊd ʌp wɛn ðə hɔl wɛnt dɑrk./
dialogue.zh: 走廊一暗，大家都站了起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some kept reading, their small lamps made stars.
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌm kɛpt ˈridɪŋ ðɛr smɔl læmps meɪd stɑrz./
dialogue.zh: 有人還在讀，小燈像星星一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine makes no star, it lights just my chin.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn meɪks noʊ stɑr ɪt laɪts dʒʌst maɪ tʃɪn./
dialogue.zh: 我的那盞不亮，只照到我的下巴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Aim it at the page, not your face.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪm ɪt ət ðə peɪdʒ nɑt jɔr feɪs./
dialogue.zh: 對著書頁照，不要對著臉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could someone knock my lamp off by mistake?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd ˈsʌmwʌn nɑk maɪ læmp ɔf baɪ mɪˈsteɪk?/
dialogue.zh: 會不會有人不小心把我的燈撞掉？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It screws in tight, twist it once more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt skrʊz ɪn taɪt twɪst ɪt wʌns mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 它是鎖緊的，你再轉一下更穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The guard passed twice without a single word.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡɑrd pæst twaɪs wɪˈðaʊt ə ˈsɪŋɡəl wɜrd./
dialogue.zh: 車長經過兩次，一句話都沒說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Her shoes are felt, they make no sound.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɜr ʃuz ɑr fɛlt ðeɪ meɪk noʊ saʊnd./
dialogue.zh: 她穿絨布鞋，走路沒有聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I whisper if I want some water?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ ˈwɪspər ɪf aɪ wɑnt sʌm ˈwɔtər?/
dialogue.zh: 如果我想喝水，要小聲一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, just get up slow, no words needed.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ dʒʌst ɡɛt ʌp sloʊ noʊ wɜrdz ˈnidəd./
dialogue.zh: 不用，慢慢起身，不用講話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the big light truly gone now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə bɪɡ laɪt ˈtruli ɡɔn naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 大燈真的全關了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gone, only the floor strip glows green now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑn ˈoʊnli ðə flɔr strɪp ɡloʊz ɡrin naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 關了，只有地上的綠燈條亮著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Green strip, good, I can find the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡrin strɪp ɡʊd aɪ kæn faɪnd ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 有綠燈條就好，我找得到門。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Follow it out, the tap is past room eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɑloʊ ɪt aʊt ðə tæp ɪz pæst rum eɪt./
dialogue.zh: 沿著走出去，水龍頭在八號房後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone is still on the phone two doors down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmwʌn ɪz stɪl ɑn ðə foʊn tu dɔrz daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 隔兩道門還有人在講電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He moves to the doorway at the end.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi muvz tu ðə ˈdɔrˌweɪ ət ði ɛnd./
dialogue.zh: 他會走到車尾那塊空地。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Calls must wait till morning, is that the rule?
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔlz mʌst weɪt tɪl ˈmɔrnɪŋ ɪz ðæt ðə rul?/
dialogue.zh: 打電話一定要等到早上嗎，有這條規定？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not calls, just voices low and short.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt kɔlz dʒʌst ˈvɔɪsɪz loʊ ænd ʃɔrt./
dialogue.zh: 不是不給講，只是聲音要小要短。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My screen glow is bright, I keep it down.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ skrin ɡloʊ ɪz braɪt aɪ kip ɪt daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 我的手機螢幕很亮，我把它調低。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Face it to the wall, the light stays small.
dialogue.phonetic: /feɪs ɪt tu ðə wɔl ðə laɪt steɪz smɔl./
dialogue.zh: 讓它對著牆，光就不會亂跑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The curtain hides my lamp from the hall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkɜrtən haɪdz maɪ læmp frʌm ðə hɔl./
dialogue.zh: 簾子一拉，走廊就看不到我的燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pull it shut, then no one sees a thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊl ɪt ʃʌt ðɛn noʊ wʌn siz ə θɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 拉到底，就沒有一個人在看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my curtain closed all the way down?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz maɪ ˈkɜrtən kloʊzd ɔl ðə weɪ daʊn?/
dialogue.zh: 我的簾子有拉到最底部嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A hand wide at the bottom lets cold in.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə hænd waɪd ət ðə ˈbɑtəm lɛts koʊld ɪn./
dialogue.zh: 底下留一掌寬，冷風就會鑽進來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cold comes through, my neck feels the glass.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊld kʌmz θru maɪ nɛk filz ðə ɡlæs./
dialogue.zh: 冷氣進來了，我脖子貼到玻璃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stack your coat against the window edge.
dialogue.phonetic: /stæk jɔr koʊt əˈɡɛnst ðə ˈwɪndoʊ ɛdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 把外套堆在窗邊擋一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Coat built like a small wall, clever trick.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊt bɪlt laɪk ə smɔl wɔl ˈklɛvər trɪk./
dialogue.zh: 外套堆成小牆，這招真聰明。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Guests teach each other, I learn it too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɛsts titʃ itʃ ˈʌðər aɪ lɜrn ɪt tu./
dialogue.zh: 乘客會互相教，我也學起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bed rocks slow, like a boat at sea.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɛd rɑks sloʊ laɪk ə boʊt ət si./
dialogue.zh: 床慢慢搖，像海上的小船。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rocking helps some people sleep right away.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɑksɪŋ hɛlps sʌm ˈpipəl slip raɪt əˈweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 搖著搖著，有些人馬上就睡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have earplugs for my loud neighbor?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hæv ˈɪrˌplʌɡz fɔr maɪ laʊd ˈnebɚ?/
dialogue.zh: 有沒有耳塞？我隔壁打呼很響。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lady below snores, but very soft.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈleɪdi bɪˈloʊ snɔrz bʌt ˈvɛri sɔft./
dialogue.zh: 下面那鋪的女士會打呼，但很輕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then no earplugs, her breath is like rain.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn noʊ ˈɪrˌplʌɡz hɜr brɛθ ɪz laɪk reɪn./
dialogue.zh: 那不用耳塞了，她呼吸像下雨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small rain, steady rain, that is the best kind.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl reɪn ˈstɛdi reɪn ðæt ɪz ðə bɛst kaɪnd./
dialogue.zh: 小雨、穩定的雨，那種最好睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My ladder folds flat, so nobody climbs late.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈlædər foʊldz flæt soʊ ˈnoʊbədi klaɪmz leɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我的梯子收平了，就沒有人深夜爬來爬去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it out, the train may stop twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ɪt aʊt ðə treɪn meɪ stɑp twaɪs./
dialogue.zh: 還是留著吧，車可能停兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stop at night means lights in the hall?
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑp ət naɪt minz laɪts ɪn ðə hɔl?/
dialogue.zh: 半夜停車就會有走廊燈？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The green strip stays, the big lamps sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡrin strɪp steɪz ðə bɪɡ læmps slip./
dialogue.zh: 綠燈條一直在，大燈繼續睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half past twelve, and I am still awake.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf pæst twɛlv ænd aɪ æm stɪl əˈweɪk./
dialogue.zh: 十二點半了，我還醒著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Count the wheel beats, one two, like drums.
dialogue.phonetic: /kaʊnt ðə wil bits wʌn tu laɪk drʌmz./
dialogue.zh: 數車輪的聲音，一二，像打鼓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One two, one two, my eyes got heavy.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn tu wʌn tu maɪ aɪz ɡɑt ˈhɛvi./
dialogue.zh: 一二，一二，我的眼睛變得很重。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That trick works best, most sleep within two hours.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt trɪk wɜrks bɛst moʊst slip wɪˈðɪn tu ˈaʊərz./
dialogue.zh: 那招最有用的，多數人兩小時內就睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A long tunnel now, the ears feel full.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə lɔŋ ˈtʌnəl naʊ ðə ɪrz fil fʊl./
dialogue.zh: 進長隧道了，耳朵聽起來悶悶的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tunnels roar eight seconds, then all goes quiet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtʌnəlz rɔr eɪt ˈsɛkəndz ðɛn ɔl ɡoʊz ˈkwaɪət./
dialogue.zh: 隧道會轟八秒，然後整個安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It roared, and now the wheels hum alone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt rɔrd ænd naʊ ðə wilz hʌm əˈloʊn./
dialogue.zh: 剛剛轟過，現在只有車輪在嗡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hum is the sound of the whole night.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm ɪz ðə saʊnd ʌv ðə hoʊl naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 嗡嗡聲就是整夜的聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone coughed two cars away, then stopped.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmwʌn kɔft tu kɑrz əˈweɪ ðɛn stɑpt./
dialogue.zh: 隔兩節車有人咳了幾下，就停了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm water helps that cough, I brought a cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm ˈwɔtər hɛlps ðæt kɔf aɪ brɔt ə kʌp./
dialogue.zh: 熱水能止咳，我已經送一杯過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You are awake too, at one in the morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr əˈweɪk tu ət wʌn ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 凌晨一點，你也還醒著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two rounds a night, that is my job.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu raʊndz ə naɪt ðæt ɪz maɪ dʒɑb./
dialogue.zh: 一晚巡兩次，這就是我的工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your round is soft, I only felt the floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr raʊnd ɪz sɔft aɪ ˈoʊnli fɛlt ðə flɔr./
dialogue.zh: 你巡邏得好輕，我只感覺到地板動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Felt shoes and one small lamp, nothing more.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛlt ʃuz ænd wʌn smɔl læmp ˈnʌθɪŋ mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 絨布鞋加一支小燈，沒有別的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Moonlight cuts a line across my blanket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmunˌlaɪt kʌts ə laɪn əˈkrɔs maɪ ˈblæŋkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 月光在我的毯子上切出一條線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The blind has one gap, not fixable now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə blaɪnd hæz wʌn ɡæp nɑt ˈfɪksəbəl naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 簾子有一條縫，現在修不好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I will sleep beside the moon line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ wɪl slip bəˈsaɪd ðə mun laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 那我就睡在月光線旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice thought, the train makes its own stars.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs θɔt ðə treɪn meɪks ɪts oʊn stɑrz./
dialogue.zh: 這樣想很好，火車有自己的星星。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My water sits low, within one arm reach.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈwɔtər sɪts loʊ wɪˈðɪn wʌn ɑrm ritʃ./
dialogue.zh: 我的水瓶放低了，伸手就拿到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, you will not need the ladder twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt ju wɪl nɑt nid ðə ˈlædər twaɪs./
dialogue.zh: 很完美，你就不用半夜爬兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Door locked, chain on, and card inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɔr lɑkt tʃeɪn ɑn ænd kɑrd ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 門鎖了，安全鏈扣上，卡留在裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, night riders never open without a knock.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naɪt ˈraɪdərz ˈnɛvər ˈoʊpən wɪˈðaʊt ə nɑk./
dialogue.zh: 很好，夜班人員不敲門絕不開門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Riders? You mean staff on the night shift.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈraɪdərz ju min stæf ɑn ðə naɪt ʃɪft?/
dialogue.zh: 夜行者？你是說上夜班的人員。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, four of us, two sleep, two walk.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs fɔr ʌv ʌs tu slip tu wɔk./
dialogue.zh: 對，我們四個，兩個睡，兩個走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four people guard six hundred sleeping guests.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ˈpipəl ɡɑrd sɪks ˈhʌndrəd ˈslipɪŋ ɡɛsts./
dialogue.zh: 四個人守護六百個睡著的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And we know each bed by its card.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd wi noʊ itʃ bɛd baɪ ɪts kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 而且我們靠門卡認每一張床。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My card says car four, room twelve, upper.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ kɑrd sɛz kɑr fɔr rum twɛlv ˈʌpər./
dialogue.zh: 我的卡寫四號車十二房，上舖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, I write it on my small board.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt aɪ raɪt ɪt ɑn maɪ smɔl bɔrd./
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，我會寫在我那塊小板上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A board with names, that is very old style.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə bɔrd wɪð neɪmz ðæt ɪz ˈvɛri oʊld staɪl./
dialogue.zh: 掛名字的木板，很老派的作法。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Paper never dies at three in the morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪpər ˈnɛvər daɪz ət θri ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 三更半夜，紙本永遠不會當機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three is far away, my eyes are closing now.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ɪz fɑr əˈweɪ maɪ aɪz ɑr ˈkloʊzɪŋ naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 三點還很遠，我的眼睛要閉上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then rest, I switch the hall strip to dim.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn rɛst aɪ swɪtʃ ðə hɔl strɪp tu dɪm./
dialogue.zh: 那就睡吧，我把走廊燈條調更暗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dimmer green, like a night garden path.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdɪmər ɡrin laɪk ə naɪt ˈɡɑrdən pæθ./
dialogue.zh: 更暗的綠，像夜裡花園的小路。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the aim, soft light, soft steps.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ði eɪm sɔft laɪt sɔft stɛps./
dialogue.zh: 目標就是這樣，光柔，腳步也柔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The whistle at one made my heart jump.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈwɪsəl ət wʌn meɪd maɪ hɑrt dʒʌmp./
dialogue.zh: 一點那聲笛害我的心跳了一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A freight train crossed us, nothing else.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə freɪt treɪn krɔst ʌs ˈnʌθɪŋ ɛls./
dialogue.zh: 是一輛貨車跟我們交會，沒別的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Freight at this hour, the world is awake.
dialogue.phonetic: /freɪt ət ðɪs ˈaʊər ðə wɜrd ɪz əˈweɪk./
dialogue.zh: 這個時辰還有貨車，世界其實醒著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the cargo, sleep, we are almost there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ðə ˈkɑrɡoʊ slip wi ɑr ˈɔlmoʊst ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 只有貨物在跑，睡吧，我們快到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Almost there means morning tea, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlmoʊst ðɛr minz ˈmɔrnɪŋ ti raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 快到了是指早上的茶，對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, six o'clock, then the town at nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs sɪks əˈklɑk ðɛn ðə taʊn ət naɪn./
dialogue.zh: 對，六點有茶，九點進城。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six sharp, and I want the strong coffee.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ʃɑrp ænd aɪ wɑnt ðə strɔŋ ˈkɔfi./
dialogue.zh: 六點整，我要那杯濃咖啡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Strong one waits in car nine, no trouble.
dialogue.phonetic: /strɔŋ wʌn weɪts ɪn kɑr naɪn noʊ ˈtrʌbəl./
dialogue.zh: 濃的在九號車備著，不麻煩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good night, guard, your steps are very kind.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naɪt ɡɑrd jɔr stɛps ɑr ˈvɛri kaɪnd./
dialogue.zh: 晚安，車長，你的腳步好溫柔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good night, guest, the bed is yours to keep.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naɪt ɡɛst ðə bɛd ɪz jɔrz tu kip./
dialogue.zh: 晚安，這張床就交給你了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I pull the blanket up to my chin now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ pʊl ðə ˈblæŋkɪt ʌp tu maɪ tʃɪn naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我把毯子拉到下巴這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The train tips slow, sleep with the tilt.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə treɪn tɪps sloʊ slip wɪð ðə tɪlt./
dialogue.zh: 車慢慢傾，跟著那個傾斜入睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: With the tilt, yes, my shoulders finally drop.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪð ðə tɪlt jɛs maɪ ˈʃoʊldərz ˈfaɪnəli drɑp./
dialogue.zh: 跟著傾斜，我的肩膀終於放下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is sleep starting, I can hear you breathe.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz slip ˈstɑrtɪŋ aɪ kæn hɪr ju brið./
dialogue.zh: 那是睡意開始了，我聽見你的呼吸了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hear me breathe, then you may sleep too.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr mi brið ðɛn ju meɪ slip tu?/
dialogue.zh: 既然聽見我呼吸，你也可以睡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I nap sitting, one eye on the clock.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ næp ˈsɪtɪŋ wʌn aɪ ɑn ðə klɑk./
dialogue.zh: 我坐著打盹，一隻眼看著時鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The hall lamp dims, the whole car sleeps.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hɔl læmp dɪmz ðə hoʊl kɑr slips./
dialogue.zh: 走廊燈暗了，整節車都睡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep deep, the wheels will guard you till dawn.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip dip ðə wilz wɪl ɡɑrd ju tɪl dɔn./
dialogue.zh: 睡沉一點，車輪會陪你到天亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My throat woke me up at two ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ θroʊt wʊk mi ʌp æt tu tɛn/
dialogue.zh: 我的喉嚨在兩點十分把我弄醒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cup waits on the shelf by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kʌp weɪts ɑn ðə ʃɛlf baɪ ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 杯子就放在門邊的架子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which way is the water in this car?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ weɪ ɪz ðə ˈwɔtər ɪn ðɪs kɑr/
dialogue.zh: 這一節車廂裡，取水要往哪邊走？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Walk toward the green strip on the floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔk təˈwɔrd ðə ɡrin strɪp ɑn ðə flɔr/
dialogue.zh: 沿著地板上的綠色條往前走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not turn on the bright lamp yet.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt tɜrn ɑn ðə braɪt læmp jɛt./
dialogue.zh: 先別把明亮的台燈全打開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The small red light shows where to stand.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə smɔl rɛd laɪt ʃoʊz wɛr tu stænd/
dialogue.zh: 那盞紅色小燈會告訴你該站哪裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My feet found slippers under the seat.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ fit faʊnd ˈslɪpərz ˈʌndər ðə sit/
dialogue.zh: 我的腳在座位下面摸到了拖鞋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep them, the corridor steel is so cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /kiːp ðɛm ðə ˈkɔrədɔr stil ɪz soʊ koʊld/
dialogue.zh: 就穿著吧，走廊的金屬地面很涼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This ladder makes a sound when I step.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈlædər meɪks ə saʊnd wɛn aɪ stɛp/
dialogue.zh: 我踩這把梯子的時候它會響。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press your weight on the middle two rungs.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɛs jɔr weɪt ɑn ðə ˈmɪdəl tu rʌŋz/
dialogue.zh: 把體重壓在中間那兩根橫檔上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the tap at the end or here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə tæp æt ði ɛnd ɔr hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 水龍頭是在走道盡頭還是就在這裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two doors past the curtain, on your left.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu dɔrz pæst ðə ˈkɜrtən ɑn jɔr lɛft/
dialogue.zh: 簾幕再過去兩扇門，你的左手邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone is drinking there already, so quietly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmwʌn ɪz ˈdrɪŋkɪŋ ðɛr ɔlˈrɛdi soʊ ˈkwaɪətli/
dialogue.zh: 已經有人在那裡喝水了，好安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nod, she will slide the cup to you.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑd ʃi wɪl slaɪd ðə kʌp tu ju/
dialogue.zh: 點頭就好，她會把杯子推給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two taps, one blue and one marked hot.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu tæps wʌn blu ænd wʌn mɑrkt hɑt/
dialogue.zh: 兩個龍頭，一個藍色，一個寫著熱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start blue, then add hot by a little.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑrt blu ðɛn æd hɑt baɪ ə ˈlɪtəl/
dialogue.zh: 先開藍色，再讓熱水進一點點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cold water tastes like iron all night long.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊld ˈwɔtər teɪsts laɪk ˈaɪərn ɔl naɪt lɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 整夜涼水的味道都有一點像鐵。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It comes from old pipes under the floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kʌmz frʌm oʊld paɪps ˈʌndər ðə flɔr/
dialogue.zh: 那是地板下面老水管的味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I fill the whole bottle for morning?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ fɪl ðə hoʊl ˈbɑtəl fɔr ˈmɔrnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我可以在天亮前把整瓶裝滿嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but leave one cup for the next person.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs bʌt liv wʌn kʌp fɔr ðə nɛkst ˈpɜrsən/
dialogue.zh: 可以，但要留一杯給下一個人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Paper cups live inside a small clear bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪpər kʌps lɪv ɪnˈsaɪd ə smɔl klɪr bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 紙杯都收在一個透明小袋裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Under the sink, beside the folded brown towels.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌndər ðə sɪŋk bəˈsaɪd ðə ˈfoʊldɪd braʊn ˈtaʊəlz/
dialogue.zh: 在水槽下面，旁邊是摺好的棕色毛巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I counted five doors and I was wrong.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈkaʊntɪd faɪv dɔrz ænd aɪ wʌz rɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我數了五扇門，結果數錯了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The first door is the guard room, no water.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə fɜrst dɔr ɪz ðə ɡɑrd rum noʊ ˈwɔtər./
dialogue.zh: 第一道門是車長室，那裡沒有水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A man with a torch asked what I do.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə mæn wɪð ə tɔrtʃ æskt wʌt aɪ du/
dialogue.zh: 拿手電筒的人問我在做什麼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say only water, and he will let you pass.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ ˈoʊnli ˈwɔtər ænd hi wɪl lɛt ju pæs/
dialogue.zh: 只說喝水，他就會讓你過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Corridor walls hum when the train leans.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɔrədɔr wɔlz hʌm wɛn ðə treɪn linz/
dialogue.zh: 列車傾斜時，走廊的牆會低聲嗡鳴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold the wall rail with your free hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ðə wɔl reɪl wɪð jɔr fri hænd/
dialogue.zh: 另一隻手扶住牆上那根桿子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One hard brake and hot water splashed.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn hɑrd breɪk ænd hɑt ˈwɔtər splæʃt./
dialogue.zh: 煞車煞得猛，熱水都噴出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit on the floor, drink, then stand again.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt ɑn ðə flɔr drɪŋk ðɛn stænd əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 先坐在地板上喝完，再站起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So many people wake for water at night.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈmɛni ˈpipəl weɪk fɔr ˈwɔtər æt naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 夜裡原來這麼多人都醒著找水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most do, the line at the tap grows.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst du ðə laɪn ət ðə tæp ɡroʊz./
dialogue.zh: 是呀，水龍頭前排起小隊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My bed mate asked me for two cups.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ bɛd meɪt æskt mi fɔr tu kʌps/
dialogue.zh: 我鋪位的夥伴請我幫他帶兩杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One hand each, the lids keep the dust out.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn hænd itʃ ðə lɪdz kip ðə dʌst aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 一手端一杯，杯蓋能擋掉灰塵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can hot water help a dry tickle throat?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn hɑt ˈwɔtər hɛlp ə draɪ ˈtɪkəl θroʊt/
dialogue.zh: 溫水能救我那種癢癢的喉嚨嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sip slow, it coats the throat like warm milk.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪp sloʊ ɪt koʊts ðə θroʊt laɪk wɔrm mɪlk/
dialogue.zh: 小口慢慢喝，它像溫牛奶一樣裹住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I burned my tongue on the first big gulp.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ bɜrnd maɪ tʌŋ ɑn ðə fɜrst bɪɡ ɡʌlp/
dialogue.zh: 第一大口就把我的舌頭燙到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Test the back of your hand before sipping.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛst ðə bæk əv jɔr hænd bɪˈfɔr ˈsɪpɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 喝之前先用手背試一下溫度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Above the sink the mirror is very foggy.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbʌv ðə sɪŋk ðə ˈmɪrər ɪz ˈvɛri ˈfɔɡi/
dialogue.zh: 水槽上方的那面鏡子全是霧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wipe a circle with the edge of your sleeve.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪp ə ˈsɜrkəl wɪð ði ɛdʒ ʌv jɔr sliv/
dialogue.zh: 用袖口邊緣擦出一個圓就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I brush teeth now, or in the morning?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ brʌʃ θiːθ naʊ ɔr ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 我現在就刷牙，還是等早上再刷？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Skip the paste, water alone will clean enough.
dialogue.phonetic: /skɪp ðə peɪst ˈwɔtər əˈloʊn wɪl klin ɪˈnʌf/
dialogue.zh: 不用牙膏了，光是水就夠乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My lips are dry from the air vent.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ lɪps ɑr draɪ frʌm ði ɛr vɛnt/
dialogue.zh: 我的嘴唇被通風口吹得好乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is cream in the drawer, small blue tin.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz krim ɪn ðə drɔr smɔl blu tɪn/
dialogue.zh: 抽屜裡有一小盒藍色的唇霜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I closed the door soft so nobody wakes.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kloʊzd ðə dɔr sɔft soʊ ˈnoʊbədi weɪks/
dialogue.zh: 我把門輕輕關上，怕吵醒誰。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, use the handle, the latch clicks too loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd juz ðə ˈhændəl ðə lætʃ klɪks tu laʊd/
dialogue.zh: 很好，門閘聲音大，改用把手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The whole train feels like one long room.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hoʊl treɪn filz laɪk wʌn lɔŋ rum./
dialogue.zh: 整列火車這時像一間很長的房間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every door opening is a short hall of echoes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri dɔr ˈoʊpnɪŋ ɪz ə ʃɔrt hɔl ʌv ˈɛkoʊz/
dialogue.zh: 每一扇門開開都像短短的回音廊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I saw the moon through the last window.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ sɔ ðə mun θru ðə læst ˈwɪnədoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我在最後一扇窗看見了月亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It rides beside us for a mile or two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt raɪdz bəˈsaɪd ʌs fɔr ə maɪl ɔr tu/
dialogue.zh: 它陪我們走上一兩英里呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A freight train passed and shook my cup half.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə freɪt treɪn pæst ænd ʃʊk maɪ kʌp hæf/
dialogue.zh: 一列貨車擦身而過，灑掉我半杯水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold the cup low, near your chest, that helps.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ðə kʌp loʊ nɪr jɔr tʃɛst ðæt hɛlps/
dialogue.zh: 杯子放低、靠近胸口就不會潑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gray towels are for hands, not for faces.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪ ˈtaʊəlz ɑr fɔr hændz nɑt fɔr ˈfeɪsəz/
dialogue.zh: 灰色毛巾是給手用的，不是擦臉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the paper square, it sits by the tap.
dialogue.phonetic: /juːz ðə ˈpeɪpər skwɛr ɪt sɪts baɪ ðə tæp/
dialogue.zh: 用擦手紙吧，它就掛在龍頭旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do crew members sleep at all in these nights?
dialogue.phonetic: /du kruː ˈmɛmbərz slip æt ɔl ɪn ðiz naɪts/
dialogue.zh: 工作人員在這種夜裡到底會睡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They take turns, one is up every two hours.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ teɪk tɜrnz wʌn ɪz ʌp ˈɛvri tu ˈaʊərz/
dialogue.zh: 他們輪流值班，每兩小時換一班。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One of them sang while filling the kettle.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ʌv ðɛm sæŋ waɪl ˈfɪlɪŋ ðə ˈkɛtl/
dialogue.zh: 有一個人邊燒水邊輕輕唱了一句。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soft songs, the sleepers never hear the words.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔft sɔŋz ðə ˈsliːpərz ˈnɛvər hɪr ði wɜrdz/
dialogue.zh: 歌很輕，睡著的人聽不清楚字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hands were cold, so I warmed them first.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hændz wər koʊld soʊ aɪ wɔrmd ðɛm fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 我的手很冰，所以先暖了一會兒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Under the warm tap, then rub them together.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌndər ðə wɔrm tæp ðɛn rʌb ðɛm təˈɡɛðər/
dialogue.zh: 在溫水下滑一滑，再互相搓熱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the water stop if I leave it running?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðə ˈwɔtər stɑp ɪf aɪ liv ɪt ˈrʌnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 如果我讓水一直流它會自己停嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it runs till you close it by hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ɪt rʌnz tɪl ju kloʊz ɪt baɪ hænd/
dialogue.zh: 不會，要你自己動手把它關掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My shelf cup has a small cracked rim.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ʃɛlf kʌp hæz ə smɔl krækt rɪm/
dialogue.zh: 我架上那個杯子杯口有一道裂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Trade it, the safe cups hang inside the locker.
dialogue.phonetic: /treɪd ɪt ðə seɪf kʌps hæŋ ɪnˈsaɪd ðə ˈlɑkər/
dialogue.zh: 換一個吧，好杯子收在櫥子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I drank too much and now I must go.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ dræŋk tu mʌtʃ ænd naʊ aɪ mʌst ɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我喝太多了，現在得去上洗手間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The small room is past the crew seat, hurry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə smɔl rum ɪz pæst ðə kruː sit ˈhɜri/
dialogue.zh: 洗手間在服務座位那頭，快去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Back in my bed the sheets still hold heat.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæk ɪn maɪ bɛd ðə ʃiːts stɪl hoʊld hiːt/
dialogue.zh: 回到鋪上，床單還留著我的溫度。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slide in slow, the mattress is warm from you.
dialogue.phonetic: /slaɪd ɪn sloʊ ðə ˈmætrəs ɪz wɔrm frʌm ju/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢滑進去，床墊還被你睡溫了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ladder rungs are freezing under my bare feet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlædər rʌŋz ɑr ˈfriːzɪŋ ˈʌndər maɪ bɛr fit/
dialogue.zh: 梯子橫檔踩下去冰得嚇人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wear the slippers, they wait beside the curtain hook.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ðə ˈslɪpərz ðeɪ weɪt bəˈsaɪd ðə ˈkɜrtən hʊk/
dialogue.zh: 穿拖鞋吧，它們就在簾鉤旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who left a glass box on the corridor floor?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu lɛft ə ɡlæs bɑks ɑn ðə ˈkɔrədɔr flɔr/
dialogue.zh: 誰把一個玻璃盒放在走廊地上？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cleaner keeps her box by the crew seat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkliːnər kips hɜr bɑks baɪ ðə kru sit./
dialogue.zh: 打掃的阿姨把箱子放在服務座位旁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want a small light for the way back.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɑnt ə smɔl laɪt fɔr ðə weɪ bæk/
dialogue.zh: 我想帶一盞小燈照回鋪的路。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The floor strip glows green all night, follow it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə flɔr strɪp ɡloʊz ɡrin ɔl naɪt ˈfɑloʊ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 地板的綠條整夜都亮，跟著它走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two ten, two thirty, and the train is slower.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu tɛn tu ˈθɜrti ænd ðə treɪn ɪz ˈsloʊər/
dialogue.zh: 兩點十分、兩點半，火車變慢了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They climb the hill, so the lights stay low.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ klaɪm ðə hɪl soʊ ðə laɪts steɪ loʊ/
dialogue.zh: 他們在爬長坡，燈光也壓得更暗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My throat is better, thanks to the warm cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ θroʊt ɪz ˈbɛtər θæŋks tu ðə wɔrm kʌp/
dialogue.zh: 我的喉嚨好多了，多虧那杯溫水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put the cup back, rinse it, dry it well.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ðə kʌp bæk rɪns ɪt draɪ ɪt wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 把杯子放回，沖一下，再擦乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I wash the cup or leave it?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ wɑʃ ðə kʌp ɔr liv ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 這杯子是我自己洗還是留著？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rinse only, the crew washes at four fifteen.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪns ˈoʊnli ðə kruː ˈwɑʃəz æt fɔr fɪfˈtin/
dialogue.zh: 沖一沖就好，四點十五他們會洗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four fifteen is early for a tired traveler.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr fɪfˈtin ɪz ˈɜrli fɔr ə ˈtaɪərd ˈtrævlər/
dialogue.zh: 四點十五對累壞的旅客太早了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They start before dawn, that is the sleeper rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ stɑrt bɪˈfɔr dɔn ðæt ɪz ðə ˈsliːpər rul/
dialogue.zh: 他們天亮前就開工，這是夜車規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bed below me rolled and muttered good night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɛd bɪˈloʊ mi roʊld ænd ˈmʌtərd ɡʊd naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我下面那鋪翻了個身，嘟噥說晚安。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wave in the dark, words are enough now.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪv ɪn ðə dɑrk wɜrdz ɑr ɪˈnʌf naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 在黑暗裡擺擺手就行，不必多話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I left the blanket folded on the far side.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ lɛft ðə ˈblæŋkɪt ˈfoʊldəd ɑn ðə fɑr saɪd/
dialogue.zh: 我把毯子疊好放在靠裡那一側。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pull it up, the cold comes through the glass.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊl ɪt ʌp ðə koʊld kʌmz θru ðə ɡlæs/
dialogue.zh: 拉蓋上來吧，冷氣會從玻璃滲進。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The frost makes a skin on half the glass.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə frɔst meɪks ə skɪn ɑn hæf ðə ɡlæs./
dialogue.zh: 窗上結了一層薄薄的白霜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Trace one line, the snow will hide it soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /treɪs wʌn laɪn ðə snoʊ wɪl haɪd ɪt suːn/
dialogue.zh: 用手指畫一條線，一下又被雪遮住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I hang my coat on the door hook?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ hæŋ maɪ koʊt ɑn ðə dɔr hʊk/
dialogue.zh: 我的外套可以掛在門後的鉤上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it keeps your shoulders warm at morning tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt kips jɔr ˈʃoʊldərz wɔrm æt ˈmɔrnɪŋ ti/
dialogue.zh: 可以，早茶時你的肩膀會暖得多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The train gave one long breath, then slowed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə treɪn ɡeɪv wʌn lɔŋ brɛθ ðɛn sloʊd./
dialogue.zh: 火車長長吐了一口氣，慢了下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A signal stop, it lasts a minute, maybe two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈsɪɡnəl stɑp ɪt læsts ə ˈmɪnɪt ˈmeɪbi tu/
dialogue.zh: 是訊號停車，一分鐘，也許兩分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Night train silence is a kind of music.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪt treɪn ˈsaɪləns ɪz ə kaɪnd ʌv ˈmjuːzɪk/
dialogue.zh: 夜裡的火車一安靜，就變成一種音樂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hums, clicks and one cup set down carefully.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌmz klɪks ænd wʌn kʌp sɛt daʊn ˈkɛrfəli/
dialogue.zh: 嗡鳴、咔噠，還有杯子輕輕放下的聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will not need water again before dawn.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl nɑt nid ˈwɔtər əˈɡɛn bɪˈfɔr dɔn/
dialogue.zh: 我想天亮前不用再起來找水了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep the cup full, just in case you wake.
dialogue.phonetic: /kiːp ðə kʌp fʊl dʒʌst ɪn keɪs ju weɪk/
dialogue.zh: 杯子還是留滿，以防你又醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time the cup stays by my bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst taɪm ðə kʌp steɪz baɪ maɪ bɛd/
dialogue.zh: 下次我要把杯子就放在床邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good night, the wheels will carry you to morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naɪt ðə wiːlz wɪl ˈkæri ju tu ˈmɔrnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 晚安，車輪會一路把你送到早晨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One last sip, then the dark feels soft again.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn læst sɪp ðɛn ðə dɑrk filz sɔft əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 最後一小口，然後黑暗又變柔軟了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep now, water waits whenever you rise.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip naʊ ˈwɔtər weɪts wɛnˈɛvər ju raɪz/
dialogue.zh: 睡吧，你隨時起來水都還在。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Daylight is already pink through the glass.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdeɪlaɪt ɪz ɔlˈrɛdi pɪŋk θru ðə ɡlæs/
dialogue.zh: 天光已經在玻璃上透出粉紅了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rise slow, breakfast starts in twenty minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪz sloʊ ˈbrɛkfəst stɑrts ɪn ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnɪts/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢起來，二十分鐘後開早點車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is not enough time to wash.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz nɑt ɪˈnʌf taɪm tu wɑʃ./
dialogue.zh: 二十分鐘不夠我洗臉刷牙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cart stops at every room, just wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kɑrt stɑps ɑt ˈɛvri rum dʒʌst weɪt/
dialogue.zh: 車會在每個包廂停，你先等就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does the morning cart bring today?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt dʌz ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ kɑrt brɪŋ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 今早的點車都帶了什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Coffee, soft eggs, bread and orange juice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɔfi sɔft ɛɡz brɛd ænd ˈɔrɪndʒ dʒus/
dialogue.zh: 咖啡、軟蛋、麵包，還有柳橙汁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I pay with the card from yesterday?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ peɪ wɪð ðə kɑrd frʌm ˈjɛstərdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我能用昨天那張卡付嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the small machine rides in her apron.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə smɔl məˈʃin raɪdz ɪn hɜr ˈeɪprən/
dialogue.zh: 可以，小機器就在她的圍裙口袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six in the morning feels rude to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ filz rud tu mi/
dialogue.zh: 早上六點搭火車有點沒禮貌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep more, I will knock and wake you.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip mɔr aɪ wɪl nɑk ænd weɪk ju/
dialogue.zh: 再睡一下，我會來敲門叫你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please do not knock, the latch is loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliːz du nɑt nɑk ðə lætʃ ɪz laʊd/
dialogue.zh: 拜託別敲門，門閘聲音太大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I call your name at car four.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ kɔl jɔr neɪm æt kɑr fɔr./
dialogue.zh: 那我就在四號車喊你的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My face needs water and one fast brush.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ feɪs nidz ˈwɔtər ænd wʌn fæst brʌʃ/
dialogue.zh: 我的臉需要水，還要快刷一次牙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The sink gives hot water till six fifteen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə sɪŋk ɡɪvz hɑt ˈwɔtər tɪl sɪks fɪfˈtin/
dialogue.zh: 水槽供應熱水到六點十五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I pour out the old cup water?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ pɔr aʊt ði oʊld kʌp ˈwɔtər/
dialogue.zh: 我要不要把杯中過夜的水倒掉？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, into the sink, not on the floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈɪntu ðə sɪŋk nɑt ɑn ðə flɔr/
dialogue.zh: 要，倒進水槽，別倒在地板上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sunlight shows every crease in the sheets.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌnlaɪt ʃoʊz ˈɛvri kris ɪn ðə ʃiːts/
dialogue.zh: 陽光把床單上的摺痕全照出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fold back the blanket, the crew does that.
dialogue.phonetic: /foʊld bæk ðə ˈblæŋkɪt ðə kruː dʌz ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 毯子往後摺就行，這事由服務組做。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I make the bed like new?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ meɪk ðə bɛd laɪk nu/
dialogue.zh: 我要怎麼把床鋪整理得像新的一樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tuck the corners, smooth once, then step down.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʌk ðə ˈkɔrnərz smuð wʌns ðɛn stɛp daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 塞進四角、摸平一次，再下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The ladder is harder in the morning light.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈlædər ɪz ˈhɑrdər ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ laɪt/
dialogue.zh: 梯子在一早的光裡更難走。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Face outward, hold the rail, drop one rung.
dialogue.phonetic: /feɪs ˈaʊtwərd hoʊld ðə reɪl drɑp wʌn rʌŋ/
dialogue.zh: 面朝外、抓穩桿子，先降一格。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half asleep, I dropped my sock twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf əˈslip aɪ drɑpt maɪ sɑk twaɪs/
dialogue.zh: 我半睡半醒，襪子掉了兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It waits under your seat, sleep clings to socks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt weɪts ˈʌndər jɔr sit slip klɪŋz tu sɑks/
dialogue.zh: 它就在你座位下，睡意總黏著襪子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cart or dining room, which line is shorter?
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑrt ɔr ˈdaɪnɪŋ rum wɪtʃ laɪn ɪz ˈʃɔrtər/
dialogue.zh: 早點車還是餐車，哪一隊比較短？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cart is shorter, the room seats only six.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kɑrt ɪz ˈʃɔrtər ðə rum sits ˈoʊnli sɪks/
dialogue.zh: 點車比較短，餐車只坐得下六個人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who gets the first cup of the coffee?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu ɡɛts ðə fɜrst kʌp ʌv ðə ˈkɔfi/
dialogue.zh: 誰拿到今天的第一杯咖啡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The woman below you, she asked at dawn.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈwʊmən bɪˈloʊ ju ʃi æskt æt dɔn/
dialogue.zh: 你下面那位女士，她天亮前就說了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warm milk for the eggs, no pepper.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm mɪlk fɔr ði ɛɡz noʊ ˈpɛpər/
dialogue.zh: 蛋配溫牛奶，不要胡椒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Noted, the cook keeps the jars far back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊtəd ðə kʊk kips ðə dʒɑrz fɑr bæk/
dialogue.zh: 記下了，廚師把罐子放在最深處。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bread is still warm inside the paper bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɛd ɪz stɪl wɔrm ɪnˈsaɪd ðə ˈpeɪpər bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 麵包在紙袋裡還是溫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tear it, spread the butter thin, eat standing.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɪr ɪt sprɛd ðə ˈbʌtər θɪn it ˈstændɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 撕開，奶油抹薄一點，站著吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I take eggs back to my room?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ teɪk ɛɡz bæk tu maɪ rum/
dialogue.zh: 我可以把蛋帶回我的包廂嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the tray board folds down on the wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə treɪ bɔrd foʊldz daʊn ɑn ðə wɔl/
dialogue.zh: 可以，牆上那塊桌板會放下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Orange juice or just water, please?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔrɪndʒ dʒus ɔr dʒʌst ˈwɔtər pliːz/
dialogue.zh: 柳橙汁，還是就只要水？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Water, the juice is sour this morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɔtər ðə dʒus ɪz ˈsaʊər ðɪs ˈmɔrnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 喝水吧，今早的果汁太酸了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone left jam on my little table.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmwʌn lɛft dʒæm ɑn maɪ ˈlɪtəl ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 有人在我的小桌上留了一攤果醬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wipe it, the sticky ring came from room three.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪp ɪt ðə ˈstɪki rɪŋ keɪm frʌm rum θri/
dialogue.zh: 擦掉吧，那個黏圈來自三號包廂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much does the small breakfast cost here?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ dʌz ðə smɔl ˈbrɛkfəst kɔst hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 這裡的早點要多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free, the ticket already holds the morning plate.
dialogue.phonetic: /fri ðə ˈtɪkɪt ɔlˈrɛdi hoʊldz ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ pleɪt/
dialogue.zh: 免費，你的票已經含了早上一盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nothing! Then I will order a second egg.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ ðɛn aɪ wɪl ˈɔrdər ə ˈsɛkənd ɛɡ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了！那我要再加一顆蛋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take two, the cook packed an extra tray.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk tu ðə kʊk pækt ən ˈɛkstrə treɪ/
dialogue.zh: 拿兩顆吧，廚師多備了一盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to clear my own tray?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tu klɪr maɪ oʊn treɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我需要自己收走托盤嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave it folded, the cart returns at eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /liv ɪt ˈfoʊldəd ðə kɑrt rɪˈtɜrnz æt eɪt/
dialogue.zh: 疊好放著就行，八點車會回來收。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Radio says our train arrives at nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈreɪdioʊ sɛz ˈaʊər treɪn əˈraɪvz æt naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 廣播說我們九點到站。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine, but the fog may make it nine ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn bʌt ðə fɔɡ meɪ meɪk ɪt naɪn tɛn./
dialogue.zh: 九點，但霧可能讓它變成九點十分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did that voice just name our station?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðæt vɔɪs dʒʌst neɪm ˈaʊər ˈsteɪʃən/
dialogue.zh: 剛剛那個聲音念了我們的站名嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, twice, then it added a platform number.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs twaɪs ðɛn ɪt ˈædəd ə ˈplætfɔrm ˈnʌmbər/
dialogue.zh: 念了兩次，還加了一個月台數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which platform, I missed the fast part.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ˈplætfɔrm aɪ mɪst ðə fæst pɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 哪個月台？我漏聽最快的部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two east, and your car steps out at nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ist ænd jɔr kɑr stɛps aʊt æt naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 二號東邊，你那節車九點才下客。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine means hurry, my bag sleeps under the bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn minz ˈhɜri maɪ bæɡ slips ˈʌndər ðə bɛd/
dialogue.zh: 九點得趕，我的包睡在床下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shake it loose, the floor grip holds hard.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃeɪk ɪt lus ðə flɔr ɡrɪp hoʊldz hɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 搖一下讓它鬆，地板夾得很緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thirty minutes left and the seats change shape.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜrti ˈmɪnɪts lɛft ænd ðə sits tʃeɪndʒ ʃeɪp/
dialogue.zh: 剩三十分鐘，座位開始換形狀。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fold the bed flat, the backrest clicks upright.
dialogue.phonetic: /foʊld ðə bɛd flæt ðə ˈbækˌrɛst klɪks ʌpˈraɪt/
dialogue.zh: 床面摺平，椅背會喀一聲豎起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Upright again, like I never slept there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌpraɪt əˈɡɛn laɪk aɪ ˈnɛvər slɛpt ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 又變回直立的椅背，像我沒睡過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cushion springs remember every tired guest.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkʊʃən sprɪŋz rɪˈmɛmbər ˈɛvri ˈtaɪərd ɡɛst/
dialogue.zh: 坐墊的彈簧記得每一位疲累旅客。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any last stop before we reach the sea?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni læst stɑp bɪˈfɔr wi ritʃ ðə si/
dialogue.zh: 到海邊之前還有站要停嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One small town, ten minutes, no stepping out.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn smɔl taʊn tɛn ˈmɪnɪts noʊ ˈstɛpɪŋ aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 一個小鎮，十分鐘，不讓下車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten minutes is enough for a fast photo?
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈmɪnɪts ɪz ɪˈnʌf fɔr ə fæst ˈfoʊtoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 十分鐘夠我快速拍一張嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, doors stay shut, cameras watch the platform.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ dɔrz steɪ ʃʌt ˈkæməərz wɑtʃ ðə ˈplætfɔrm/
dialogue.zh: 不行，門會關，鏡頭都對著月台。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our lights just flickered, is that a signal?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər laɪts dʒʌst ˈflɪkərd ɪz ðæt ə ˈsɪɡnəl/
dialogue.zh: 我們的燈剛剛閃了一下，是訊號嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It means the driver sees the first roof.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt minz ðə ˈdraɪvər siz ðə fɜrst rʊf/
dialogue.zh: 那是司機看見了第一排屋頂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Soon the town will rise behind the trees.
dialogue.phonetic: /sun ðə taʊn wɪl raɪz bɪˈhaɪnd ðə triz/
dialogue.zh: 很快小鎮就會從樹後浮出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Houses, then cranes, then your long gray wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhaʊzɪz ðɛn kreɪnz ðɛn jɔr lɔŋ ɡreɪ wɔl/
dialogue.zh: 先是房子，再來是吊車，然後那堵牆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I cannot find my passport in the drawer.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈkɑnɑt faɪnd maɪ ˈpæspɔrt ɪn ðə drɔr/
dialogue.zh: 我找不到護照，抽屜裡沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the coat pocket, you hid it there.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk ðə koʊt ˈpɑkɪt ju hɪd ɪt ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 摸一下外套口袋，你藏在那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Found it, and a receipt from the cart.
dialogue.phonetic: /faʊnd ɪt ænd ə rɪˈsit frʌm ðə kɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 找到了，還有一張餐車的收據。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it, the office asks for paper sometimes.
dialogue.phonetic: /kiːp ɪt ðə ˈɔfəs æskz fɔr ˈpeɪpər ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz/
dialogue.zh: 留著吧，辦公室偶爾要紙本。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I leave the blanket folded or loose?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ liv ðə ˈblæŋkɪt ˈfoʊldəd ɔr lus/
dialogue.zh: 毯子我該疊好還是鬆著放？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Folded, on the hook, that helps the next guest.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfoʊldəd ɑn ðə hʊk ðæt hɛlps ðə nɛkst ɡɛst/
dialogue.zh: 疊好掛在鉤上，下一位會需要。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Somebody's umbrella is still in the stand.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmbɑdiz ˌʌmˈbrɛlə ɪz stɪl ɪn ðə stænd/
dialogue.zh: 傘架裡還有一把別人的傘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take none, the crew keeps lost things safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk nʌn ðə kruː kips lɔst θɪŋz seɪf/
dialogue.zh: 別拿，服務組會保管遺落的東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the wheels sound different, softer, slower.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə wiːlz saʊnd ˈdɪfərənt ˈsɔftər ˈsloʊər/
dialogue.zh: 車輪的聲音不一樣了，更輕也更慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We are on the hill line into town.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ɑr ɑn ðə hɪl laɪn ˈɪntu taʊn/
dialogue.zh: 我們已經進了進城的山坡線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five minutes! The cup must go to the sink.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ˈmɪnɪts ðə kʌp mʌst ɡoʊ tu ðə sɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 五分鐘！杯子得送去水槽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rinse it quick, a cloth hangs by the tap.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪns ɪt kwɪk ə klɔθ hæŋz baɪ ðə tæp/
dialogue.zh: 快沖一下，龍頭旁邊掛著一塊布。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I stand when the doors open?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du aɪ stænd wɛn ðə dɔrz ˈoʊpən/
dialogue.zh: 門開的時候我該站在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Behind the yellow line, bag on your shoulder.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈhaɪnd ðə ˈjɛloʊ laɪn bæɡ ɑn jɔr ˈʃoʊldər/
dialogue.zh: 黃線後面，背包掛在你的肩上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I help the gray lady with her case?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ hɛlp ðə ɡreɪ ˈleɪdi wɪð hɜr keɪs/
dialogue.zh: 我可以幫那位灰髮女士拿箱子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask first, she likes to manage her own.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk fɜrst ʃi laɪks tu ˈmænɪdʒ hɜr oʊn/
dialogue.zh: 先問她，她喜歡自己處理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The announcement named our train and one more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði əˈnaʊnmənt neɪmd ˈaʊər treɪn ænd wʌn mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 廣播報了我們的車，還有一班貨車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yours and the late freight, both use platform two.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔrz ænd ðə leɪt freɪt boʊθ juz ˈplætfɔrm tu/
dialogue.zh: 你和那班晚點的貨車，都用二月台。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Late freight means we wait right at the gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /leɪt freɪt minz wi weɪt raɪt æt ðə ɡeɪt/
dialogue.zh: 貨車遲到，我們要在閘口前等。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only a minute, stand clear, mind the gap.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ə ˈmɪnɪt stænd klɪr maɪnd ðə ɡæp/
dialogue.zh: 只一分鐘，站開一點，留意縫隙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Such a classic line, I love to hear it.
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌtʃ ə ˈklæsɪk laɪn aɪ lʌv tu hɪr ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 這句真經典，我每回都愛聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They have said it here since nineteen fifty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ hæv sɛd ɪt hɪr sɪns naɪnˈtin ˈfɪfti/
dialogue.zh: 從一九五零年起，這裡都這麼說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cars will crowd the exit, I saw it once.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑrz wɪl kraʊd ði ˈɛɡzɪt aɪ sɔ ɪt wʌns/
dialogue.zh: 出口會被人群擠滿，我看過一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stay in your place, the doors open in turn.
dialogue.phonetic: /steɪ ɪn jɔr pleɪs ðə dɔrz ˈoʊpən ɪn tɜrn/
dialogue.zh: 先留在你的位置，門會依序打開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This is it, the seats hold tight again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ɪz ɪt ðə sits hoʊld taɪt əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 就是現在，座位又緊住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost, breathe, the brake will sigh and stop.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlmoʊst brið ðə breɪk wɪl saɪ ænd stɑp/
dialogue.zh: 快好了，深呼吸，剎車會嘆一口氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We stopped! The station roof is very blue.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi stɑpt ðə ˈsteɪʃən rʊf ɪz ˈvɛri blu/
dialogue.zh: 我們停了！車站的屋頂很藍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine twenty three, a little late, but here.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ˈtwɛnti θri ə ˈlɪtəl leɪt bʌt hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 九點二十三分，遲了一點，但畢竟到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank her for the two quiet night cups.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk hɜr fɔr ðə tu ˈkwaɪət naɪt kʌps/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝她那兩杯安靜的夜水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will, she kept my lamp dim all night.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ʃi kɛpt maɪ læmp dɪm ɔl naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我會的，她整夜都把燈調得很暗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Morning tea was the part I liked best.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɔrnɪŋ ti wʌz ðə pɑrt aɪ laɪkt bɛst/
dialogue.zh: 早茶是我最喜歡的那一段。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bread, warm eggs and one slow cart bell.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɛd wɔrm ɛɡz ænd wʌn sloʊ kɑrt bɛl/
dialogue.zh: 麵包、溫蛋，還有慢慢搖的車鈴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will this same sleeper run again in June?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðɪs seɪm ˈsliːpər rʌn əˈɡɛn ɪn dʒun/
dialogue.zh: 這班夜車六月還會跑嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same track, same upper bed, ask me in August.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm træk seɪm ˈʌpər bɛd æsk mi ɪn ˈɔɡəst/
dialogue.zh: 同一條軌道、同一個上鋪，八月來問我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good trip, thank you for the ladder lessons.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd trɪp θæŋk ju fɔr ðə ˈlædər ˈlɛsənz/
dialogue.zh: 這趟真舒服，謝謝你那幾堂梯子課。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Safe walking, the kettle is on tomorrow.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪf ˈwɔkɪŋ ðə ˈkɛtl ɪz ɑn təˈmɑroʊ/
dialogue.zh: 路上小心，明天的熱水我照樣留著。
